# SCWE-124: Inconsistent Rounding Direction in Financial Math

Stable Version v1.0

This content is in the **version-(v1.0)** and still under active development, so it is subject to change any time (e.g. structure, IDs, content, URLs, etc.).

[Send Feedback](https://github.com/OWASP/www-project-smart-contract-security-testing-guide/discussions/categories/scwe-scstg-v2-beta-feedback)


## Relationships[¶](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-CODE/SCWE-124/#relationships "Permanent link")

-   CWE-682: Incorrect Calculation
    [https://cwe.mitre.org/data/definitions/682.html](https://cwe.mitre.org/data/definitions/682.html)


## Description[¶](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-CODE/SCWE-124/#description "Permanent link")

Using mixed rounding strategies (floor vs. ceil vs. truncation) across mint/burn/withdraw logic causes value drift. Attackers can cycle operations to accumulate dust gains or trigger unfair liquidations due to asymmetry.


## Remediation[¶](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-CODE/SCWE-124/#remediation "Permanent link")

-   Define and document a single rounding direction per invariant (e.g., always round in favor of the protocol or user).
-   Centralize math helpers and reuse them across all financial paths.
-   Add property-based tests to ensure invariant preservation under rounding.


## Examples[¶](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-CODE/SCWE-124/#examples "Permanent link")


### Vulnerable[¶](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-CODE/SCWE-124/#vulnerable "Permanent link")

`[](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-CODE/SCWE-124/#__codelineno-0-1)pragma solidity ^0.8.0; [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-CODE/SCWE-124/#__codelineno-0-2)[](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-CODE/SCWE-124/#__codelineno-0-3)shares = amount * totalShares / totalAssets;      // truncates [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-CODE/SCWE-124/#__codelineno-0-4)assets = shares * totalAssets / totalShares + 1;  // rounds up`


### Fixed[¶](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-CODE/SCWE-124/#fixed "Permanent link")

`[](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-CODE/SCWE-124/#__codelineno-1-1)pragma solidity ^0.8.0; [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-CODE/SCWE-124/#__codelineno-1-2)[](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-CODE/SCWE-124/#__codelineno-1-3)// consistently round down (or up) and state it explicitly [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-CODE/SCWE-124/#__codelineno-1-4)shares = amount * totalShares / totalAssets; [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-CODE/SCWE-124/#__codelineno-1-5)assets = shares * totalAssets / totalShares;`

title: SCWE-137: Read-Only Reentrancy via View Function State Staleness
heading: Vulnerable[¶](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-CODE/SCWE-137/#vulnerable "Permanent link")
text:
*Last updated: August 19, 2026*



# SCWE-137: Read-Only Reentrancy via View Function State Staleness

Stable Version v1.0

This content is in the **version-(v1.0)** and still under active development, so it is subject to change any time (e.g. structure, IDs, content, URLs, etc.).

[Send Feedback](https://github.com/OWASP/www-project-smart-contract-security-testing-guide/discussions/categories/scwe-scstg-v2-beta-feedback)


## Relationships[¶](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-CODE/SCWE-137/#relationships "Permanent link")

-   CWE-367: Time-of-check Time-of-use (TOCTOU) Race Condition
    [https://cwe.mitre.org/data/definitions/367.html](https://cwe.mitre.org/data/definitions/367.html)


## Description[¶](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-CODE/SCWE-137/#description "Permanent link")

Read-only reentrancy occurs when a `view` or `pure` function is called during an external callback (e.g., from a lending protocol reading collateral, or an integrator querying state). The view function returns stale state because the contract's effects have not yet been applied—the callback happens mid-transaction, before state updates complete. External protocols that rely on this state for critical decisions (e.g., liquidations, pricing, health checks) can be exploited to drain funds or bypass invariants.

This is distinct from classic reentrancy (SCWE-046): no state-modifying function is reentered, but the *read* of inconsistent state by external callers during a callback causes the vulnerability.


## Remediation[¶](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-CODE/SCWE-137/#remediation "Permanent link")

-   Apply `nonReentrant` guards to functions that make external calls, even if the caller only reads state—external protocols may call back into view functions.
-   Use a "read-your-writes" pattern: ensure view functions reflect in-flight state or document that they are unsafe during callbacks.
-   Integrators should not rely on view functions of contracts that perform external calls without reentrancy guards.


## Examples[¶](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-CODE/SCWE-137/#examples "Permanent link")

       [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-CODE/SCWE-137/#__codelineno-0-13)        balances[msg.sender] -= amount;        [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-CODE/SCWE-137/#__codelineno-0-14)        (bool ok, ) = msg.sender.call{value: amount}("");        [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-CODE/SCWE-137/#__codelineno-0-15)        require(ok, "Transfer failed");    [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-CODE/SCWE-137/#__codelineno-0-16)    } [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-CODE/SCWE-137/#__codelineno-0-17)    [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-CODE/SCWE-137/#__codelineno-0-18)    function getHealthFactor(address user) external view returns (uint256) {        [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-CODE/SCWE-137/#__codelineno-0-19)        return (balances[user] * 1e18) / (borrowed[user] + 1);    [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-CODE/SCWE-137/#__codelineno-0-20)    } [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-CODE/SCWE-137/#__codelineno-0-21)}`

**Why vulnerable:** During `withdraw`, the recipient's callback can invoke `getHealthFactor(user)` (e.g., from an integrator or liquidation bot). The victim's state may be mid-update or the integrator may rely on cached/stale values from the victim or dependent contracts. External protocols making decisions based on such reads can allow unhealthy borrows or incorrect liquidations.

title: SCWE-137: Read-Only Reentrancy via View Function State Staleness
heading: Fixed[¶](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-CODE/SCWE-137/#fixed "Permanent link")
text:
### Fixed[¶](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-CODE/SCWE-137/#fixed "Permanent link")

`[](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-CODE/SCWE-137/#__codelineno-1-1)pragma solidity ^0.8.0; [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-CODE/SCWE-137/#__codelineno-1-2)import "@openzeppelin/contracts/security/ReentrancyGuard.sol"; [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-CODE/SCWE-137/#__codelineno-1-3)[](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-CODE/SCWE-137/#__codelineno-1-4)contract LendingPool is ReentrancyGuard {     [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-CODE/SCWE-137/#__codelineno-1-5)    mapping(address => uint256) public balances;    [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-CODE/SCWE-137/#__codelineno-1-6)    mapping(address => uint256) public borrowed; [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-CODE/SCWE-137/#__codelineno-1-7)    [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-CODE/SCWE-137/#__codelineno-1-8)    function withdraw(uint256 amount) external nonReentrant {        [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-CODE/SCWE-137/#__codelineno-1-9)        require(balances[msg.sender] >= amount, "Insufficient");        [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-CODE/SCWE-137/#__codelineno-1-10)        balances[msg.sender] -= amount;        [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-CODE/SCWE-137/#__codelineno-1-11)        (bool ok, ) = msg.sender.call{value: amount}("");        [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-CODE/SCWE-137/#__codelineno-1-12)        require(ok, "Transfer failed");    [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-CODE/SCWE-137/#__codelineno-1-13)    } [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-CODE/SCWE-137/#__codelineno-1-14)}`

**Fix:** `nonReentrant` prevents external callbacks from reentering or being used while state is mid-update, so view functions cannot be called in an inconsistent state during the callback.

title: SCWE-141: Lack of Deadline Validation in Time-Sensitive External Calls
heading: Fixed[¶](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-CODE/SCWE-141/#fixed "Permanent link")
text:
*Last updated: August 19, 2026*



# SCWE-141: Lack of Deadline Validation in Time-Sensitive External Calls

Stable Version v1.0

This content is in the **version-(v1.0)** and still under active development, so it is subject to change any time (e.g. structure, IDs, content, URLs, etc.).

[Send Feedback](https://github.com/OWASP/www-project-smart-contract-security-testing-guide/discussions/categories/scwe-scstg-v2-beta-feedback)


## Relationships[¶](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-CODE/SCWE-141/#relationships "Permanent link")

-   CWE-20: Improper Input Validation
    [https://cwe.mitre.org/data/definitions/20.html](https://cwe.mitre.org/data/definitions/20.html)


## Description[¶](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-CODE/SCWE-141/#description "Permanent link")

Time-sensitive external calls (e.g., DEX swaps, limit orders) that use only `block.timestamp` as a deadline—or no user-supplied deadline—can be front-run or executed at unfavorable times. A user signs a transaction expecting execution within a short window, but miners/validators can delay inclusion. Without a `deadline` parameter, the transaction may execute when prices have moved adversely. SCWE-090 covers slippage; this weakness addresses the absence of explicit deadline validation.


## Remediation[¶](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-CODE/SCWE-141/#remediation "Permanent link")

-   Accept a `deadline` parameter from users and enforce `require(block.timestamp <= deadline, "Expired")` before executing time-sensitive logic.
-   Never rely solely on `block.timestamp` for user-intended time bounds without a user-supplied deadline.


## Examples[¶](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-CODE/SCWE-141/#examples "Permanent link")


### Vulnerable[¶](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-CODE/SCWE-141/#vulnerable "Permanent link")

`[](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-CODE/SCWE-141/#__codelineno-0-1)pragma solidity ^0.8.0; [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-CODE/SCWE-141/#__codelineno-0-2)[](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-CODE/SCWE-141/#__codelineno-0-3)interface IRouter {     [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-CODE/SCWE-141/#__codelineno-0-4)    function swapExactTokensForTokens(uint256 amountIn, uint256 amountOutMin, address[] calldata path, address to, uint256 deadline) external returns (uint256[] memory); [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-CODE/SCWE-141/#__codelineno-0-5)} [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-CODE/SCWE-141/#__codelineno-0-6)[](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-CODE/SCWE-141/#__codelineno-0-7)contract Swapper {     [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-CODE/SCWE-141/#__codelineno-0-8)    IRouter public router; [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-CODE/SCWE-141/#__codelineno-0-9)    [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-CODE/SCWE-141/#__codelineno-0-10)    function swap(address[] calldata path, uint256 amountIn, uint256 minOut) external {        [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-CODE/SCWE-141/#__codelineno-0-11)        router.swapExactTokensForTokens(            [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-CODE/SCWE-141/#__codelineno-0-12)            amountIn,            [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-CODE/SCWE-141/#__codelineno-0-13)            minOut,            [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-CODE/SCWE-141/#__codelineno-0-14)            path,            [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-CODE/SCWE-141/#__codelineno-0-15)            msg.sender,            [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-CODE/SCWE-141/#__codelineno-0-16)            block.timestamp  // No user deadline: tx can be delayed and executed at bad time        [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-CODE/SCWE-141/#__codelineno-0-17)        );    [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-CODE/SCWE-141/#__codelineno-0-18)    } [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-CODE/SCWE-141/#__codelineno-0-19)}`

title: SCWE-143: Critical Address Parameters Not Validated for Zero Address
heading: Fixed[¶](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-CODE/SCWE-143/#fixed "Permanent link")
text:
*Last updated: August 19, 2026*



# SCWE-143: Critical Address Parameters Not Validated for Zero Address

Stable Version v1.0

This content is in the **version-(v1.0)** and still under active development, so it is subject to change any time (e.g. structure, IDs, content, URLs, etc.).

[Send Feedback](https://github.com/OWASP/www-project-smart-contract-security-testing-guide/discussions/categories/scwe-scstg-v2-beta-feedback)


## Relationships[¶](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-CODE/SCWE-143/#relationships "Permanent link")

-   CWE-20: Improper Input Validation
    [https://cwe.mitre.org/data/definitions/20.html](https://cwe.mitre.org/data/definitions/20.html)


## Description[¶](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-CODE/SCWE-143/#description "Permanent link")

Critical address parameters (owner, oracle, fee recipient, token address) that are not validated for `address(0)` can brick the contract or cause funds to be sent to the burn address. Assigning `address(0)` as owner prevents any owner-only actions; using it as a recipient loses funds permanently. SCWE-091 covers zero *value* in token transfers; this weakness addresses zero *address*.


## Remediation[¶](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-CODE/SCWE-143/#remediation "Permanent link")

-   Validate `require(addr != address(0), "Zero address")` for all critical address parameters in constructors and setters.
-   Use custom errors for gas efficiency where appropriate.


## Examples[¶](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-CODE/SCWE-143/#examples "Permanent link")


### Vulnerable[¶](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-CODE/SCWE-143/#vulnerable "Permanent link")

`[](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-CODE/SCWE-143/#__codelineno-0-1)pragma solidity ^0.8.0; [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-CODE/SCWE-143/#__codelineno-0-2)[](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-CODE/SCWE-143/#__codelineno-0-3)contract Vault {     [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-CODE/SCWE-143/#__codelineno-0-4)    address public owner;    [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-CODE/SCWE-143/#__codelineno-0-5)    address public feeRecipient; [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-CODE/SCWE-143/#__codelineno-0-6)    [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-CODE/SCWE-143/#__codelineno-0-7)    constructor(address _owner, address _feeRecipient) {        [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-CODE/SCWE-143/#__codelineno-0-8)        owner = _owner;           // No check: address(0) bricks contract        [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-CODE/SCWE-143/#__codelineno-0-9)        feeRecipient = _feeRecipient;  // No check: fees sent to burn address    [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-CODE/SCWE-143/#__codelineno-0-10)    } [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-CODE/SCWE-143/#__codelineno-0-11)    [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-CODE/SCWE-143/#__codelineno-0-12)    function collectFees() external {        [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-CODE/SCWE-143/#__codelineno-0-13)        uint256 fees = address(this).balance;        [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-CODE/SCWE-143/#__codelineno-0-14)        (bool ok, ) = feeRecipient.call{value: fees}("");        [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-CODE/SCWE-143/#__codelineno-0-15)        require(ok, "Transfer failed");    [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-CODE/SCWE-143/#__codelineno-0-16)    } [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-CODE/SCWE-143/#__codelineno-0-17)}`


### Fixed[¶](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-CODE/SCWE-143/#fixed "Permanent link")

`[](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-CODE/SCWE-143/#__codelineno-1-1)constructor(address _owner, address _feeRecipient) {     [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-CODE/SCWE-143/#__codelineno-1-2)    require(_owner != address(0), "Invalid owner");    [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-CODE/SCWE-143/#__codelineno-1-3)    require(_feeRecipient != address(0), "Invalid fee recipient");    [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-CODE/SCWE-143/#__codelineno-1-4)    owner = _owner;    [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-CODE/SCWE-143/#__codelineno-1-5)    feeRecipient = _feeRecipient; [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-CODE/SCWE-143/#__codelineno-1-6)}`

title: SCWE-144: Bypassable Contract Existence Check via extcodesize
heading: Fixed[¶](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-CODE/SCWE-144/#fixed "Permanent link")
text:
*Last updated: August 19, 2026*



# SCWE-144: Bypassable Contract Existence Check via extcodesize

Stable Version v1.0

This content is in the **version-(v1.0)** and still under active development, so it is subject to change any time (e.g. structure, IDs, content, URLs, etc.).

[Send Feedback](https://github.com/OWASP/www-project-smart-contract-security-testing-guide/discussions/categories/scwe-scstg-v2-beta-feedback)


## Relationships[¶](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-CODE/SCWE-144/#relationships "Permanent link")

-   CWE-697: Incorrect Comparison
    [https://cwe.mitre.org/data/definitions/697.html](https://cwe.mitre.org/data/definitions/697.html)


## Description[¶](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-CODE/SCWE-144/#description "Permanent link")

Using `extcodesize(addr) > 0` to detect whether an address is a contract fails during construction. When code runs inside a constructor, `extcodesize(address(this))` returns 0 because the contract's code is not yet deployed. An attacker can deploy a contract whose constructor calls the victim—the victim sees `extcodesize(caller) == 0` and treats the caller as an EOA, bypassing contract-specific restrictions.


## Remediation[¶](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-CODE/SCWE-144/#remediation "Permanent link")

-   Do not rely on `extcodesize` to distinguish EOAs from contracts.
-   If contract-only or EOA-only logic is required, use a different mechanism (e.g., trusted registry, explicit opt-in) or accept that constructor calls cannot be distinguished.


## Examples[¶](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-CODE/SCWE-144/#examples "Permanent link")


### Vulnerable[¶](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-CODE/SCWE-144/#vulnerable "Permanent link")

`[](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-CODE/SCWE-144/#__codelineno-0-1)pragma solidity ^0.8.0; [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-CODE/SCWE-144/#__codelineno-0-2)[](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-CODE/SCWE-144/#__codelineno-0-3)contract TokenGating {     [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-CODE/SCWE-144/#__codelineno-0-4)    mapping(address => bool) public allowed; [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-CODE/SCWE-144/#__codelineno-0-5)    [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-CODE/SCWE-144/#__codelineno-0-6)    function claim() external {        [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-CODE/SCWE-144/#__codelineno-0-7)        require(extcodesize(msg.sender) == 0, "Contracts not allowed");        [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-CODE/SCWE-144/#__codelineno-0-8)        allowed[msg.sender] = true;    [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-CODE/SCWE-144/#__codelineno-0-9)    } [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-CODE/SCWE-144/#__codelineno-0-10)    [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-CODE/SCWE-144/#__codelineno-0-11)    function extcodesize(address account) internal view returns (uint256 size) {        [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-CODE/SCWE-144/#__codelineno-0-12)        assembly { size := extcodesize(account) }    [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-CODE/SCWE-144/#__codelineno-0-13)    } [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-CODE/SCWE-144/#__codelineno-0-14)}`

**Why vulnerable:** An attacker deploys `Attacker` whose constructor calls `claim()`. During the constructor, `extcodesize(Attacker) == 0`, so the check passes and the contract receives the claim.

title: SCWE-144: Bypassable Contract Existence Check via extcodesize
heading: Fixed[¶](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-CODE/SCWE-144/#fixed "Permanent link")
text:
### Fixed[¶](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-CODE/SCWE-144/#fixed "Permanent link")

`[](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-CODE/SCWE-144/#__codelineno-1-1)pragma solidity ^0.8.0; [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-CODE/SCWE-144/#__codelineno-1-2)[](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-CODE/SCWE-144/#__codelineno-1-3)contract TokenGating {     [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-CODE/SCWE-144/#__codelineno-1-4)    mapping(address => bool) public allowed;    [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-CODE/SCWE-144/#__codelineno-1-5)    mapping(address => bool) public claimed; [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-CODE/SCWE-144/#__codelineno-1-6)    [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-CODE/SCWE-144/#__codelineno-1-7)    function claim() external {        [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-CODE/SCWE-144/#__codelineno-1-8)        require(allowed[msg.sender], "Not allowed");        [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-CODE/SCWE-144/#__codelineno-1-9)        require(!claimed[msg.sender], "Already claimed");        [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-CODE/SCWE-144/#__codelineno-1-10)        claimed[msg.sender] = true;    [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-CODE/SCWE-144/#__codelineno-1-11)    } [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-CODE/SCWE-144/#__codelineno-1-12)}`

**Fix:** Use an allowlist instead of `extcodesize`. Access control is based on explicit registration, not EOA vs contract detection.

title: SCWE-146: Improper Use of try/catch Leading to Silent Failures
heading: Fixed[¶](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-CODE/SCWE-146/#fixed "Permanent link")
text:
*Last updated: August 19, 2026*



# SCWE-146: Improper Use of try/catch Leading to Silent Failures

Stable Version v1.0

This content is in the **version-(v1.0)** and still under active development, so it is subject to change any time (e.g. structure, IDs, content, URLs, etc.).

[Send Feedback](https://github.com/OWASP/www-project-smart-contract-security-testing-guide/discussions/categories/scwe-scstg-v2-beta-feedback)


## Relationships[¶](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-CODE/SCWE-146/#relationships "Permanent link")

-   CWE-390: Detection of Error Condition Without Action
    [https://cwe.mitre.org/data/definitions/390.html](https://cwe.mitre.org/data/definitions/390.html)


## Description[¶](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-CODE/SCWE-146/#description "Permanent link")

Solidity 0.6+ `try/catch` allows catching reverts from external calls. If the catch block does not properly handle the failure—e.g., proceeds without reverting, leaves state inconsistent, or swallows the error without logging—the contract can continue execution under incorrect assumptions. Silent failures can lead to fund loss, corrupted state, or exploitable inconsistencies.


## Remediation[¶](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-CODE/SCWE-146/#remediation "Permanent link")

-   In catch blocks, either revert with a clear message or update state to reflect the failure (e.g., mark operation as failed, emit event).
-   Avoid proceeding with critical logic when the external call failed unless the failure is explicitly handled and documented.


## Examples[¶](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-CODE/SCWE-146/#examples "Permanent link")


### Vulnerable[¶](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-CODE/SCWE-146/#vulnerable "Permanent link")

`[](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-CODE/SCWE-146/#__codelineno-0-1)pragma solidity ^0.8.0; [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-CODE/SCWE-146/#__codelineno-0-2)[](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-CODE/SCWE-146/#__codelineno-0-3)contract Aggregator {     [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-CODE/SCWE-146/#__codelineno-0-4)    function swap(address router, bytes calldata data) external {        [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-CODE/SCWE-146/#__codelineno-0-5)        try IRouter(router).swap(data) returns (uint256 amountOut) {            [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-CODE/SCWE-146/#__codelineno-0-6)            transferToUser(msg.sender, amountOut);        [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-CODE/SCWE-146/#__codelineno-0-7)        } catch {            [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-CODE/SCWE-146/#__codelineno-0-8)            // Silent: user gets nothing but tx succeeds; state may be inconsistent        [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-CODE/SCWE-146/#__codelineno-0-9)        }    [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-CODE/SCWE-146/#__codelineno-0-10)    } [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-CODE/SCWE-146/#__codelineno-0-11)}`


### Fixed[¶](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-CODE/SCWE-146/#fixed "Permanent link")

`[](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-CODE/SCWE-146/#__codelineno-1-1)function swap(address router, bytes calldata data) external {     [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-CODE/SCWE-146/#__codelineno-1-2)    try IRouter(router).swap(data) returns (uint256 amountOut) {        [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-CODE/SCWE-146/#__codelineno-1-3)        transferToUser(msg.sender, amountOut);    [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-CODE/SCWE-146/#__codelineno-1-4)    } catch {        [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-CODE/SCWE-146/#__codelineno-1-5)        revert("Swap failed");    [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-CODE/SCWE-146/#__codelineno-1-6)    } [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-CODE/SCWE-146/#__codelineno-1-7)}`

**Fix:** Revert in the catch block so the transaction fails. Avoid `catch (bytes memory reason)` with string concatenation—`reason` may be a custom error selector, not a string.

title: SCWE-152: Misuse of Custom Errors Leading to Information Leakage or Wrong Revert Behavior

*Last updated: August 19, 2026*



# SCWE-152: Misuse of Custom Errors Leading to Information Leakage or Wrong Revert Behavior

Stable Version v1.0

This content is in the **version-(v1.0)** and still under active development, so it is subject to change any time (e.g. structure, IDs, content, URLs, etc.).

[Send Feedback](https://github.com/OWASP/www-project-smart-contract-security-testing-guide/discussions/categories/scwe-scstg-v2-beta-feedback)


## Relationships[¶](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-CODE/SCWE-152/#relationships "Permanent link")

-   CWE-209: Generation of Error Message Containing Sensitive Information
    [https://cwe.mitre.org/data/definitions/209.html](https://cwe.mitre.org/data/definitions/209.html)


## Description[¶](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-CODE/SCWE-152/#description "Permanent link")

Custom errors (Solidity 0.8.4+) save gas but can expose internal state if parameters include sensitive data (e.g., balances, private keys, internal addresses). Using the wrong error in a revert can also mislead integrators or hide the actual failure reason. Custom errors are part of the revert payload and can be decoded off-chain.


## Remediation[¶](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-CODE/SCWE-152/#remediation "Permanent link")

-   Avoid including sensitive data in custom error parameters.
-   Use generic error messages for external-facing reverts when the internal reason is confidential.
-   Ensure error selection matches the actual failure condition.


## Examples[¶](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-CODE/SCWE-152/#examples "Permanent link")


### Vulnerable[¶](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-CODE/SCWE-152/#vulnerable "Permanent link")

`[](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-CODE/SCWE-152/#__codelineno-0-1)pragma solidity ^0.8.0; [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-CODE/SCWE-152/#__codelineno-0-2)[](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-CODE/SCWE-152/#__codelineno-0-3)contract Vault {     [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-CODE/SCWE-152/#__codelineno-0-4)    error InsufficientBalance(uint256 requested, uint256 available); [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-CODE/SCWE-152/#__codelineno-0-5)    [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-CODE/SCWE-152/#__codelineno-0-6)    function withdraw(uint256 amount) external {        [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-CODE/SCWE-152/#__codelineno-0-7)        uint256 balance = balances[msg.sender];        [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-CODE/SCWE-152/#__codelineno-0-8)        if (amount > balance) {            [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-CODE/SCWE-152/#__codelineno-0-9)            revert InsufficientBalance(amount, balance);  // Exposes user balance        [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-CODE/SCWE-152/#__codelineno-0-10)        }        [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-CODE/SCWE-152/#__codelineno-0-11)        balances[msg.sender] -= amount;        [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-CODE/SCWE-152/#__codelineno-0-12)        (bool ok, ) = msg.sender.call{value: amount}("");        [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-CODE/SCWE-152/#__codelineno-0-13)        require(ok, "Transfer failed");    [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-CODE/SCWE-152/#__codelineno-0-14)    } [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-CODE/SCWE-152/#__codelineno-0-15)}`


### Fixed[¶](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-CODE/SCWE-152/#fixed "Permanent link")

`[](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-CODE/SCWE-152/#__codelineno-1-1)error InsufficientBalance(); [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-CODE/SCWE-152/#__codelineno-1-2)[](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-CODE/SCWE-152/#__codelineno-1-3)function withdraw(uint256 amount) external {     [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-CODE/SCWE-152/#__codelineno-1-4)    if (amount > balances[msg.sender]) {        [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-CODE/SCWE-152/#__codelineno-1-5)        revert InsufficientBalance();    [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-CODE/SCWE-152/#__codelineno-1-6)    }    [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-CODE/SCWE-152/#__codelineno-1-7)    // ... [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-CODE/SCWE-152/#__codelineno-1-8)}`

*Last updated: August 19, 2026*



# SCWE-154: Calldata Decode Without Length Check

Stable Version v1.0

This content is in the **version-(v1.0)** and still under active development, so it is subject to change any time (e.g. structure, IDs, content, URLs, etc.).

[Send Feedback](https://github.com/OWASP/www-project-smart-contract-security-testing-guide/discussions/categories/scwe-scstg-v2-beta-feedback)


## Relationships[¶](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-CODE/SCWE-154/#relationships "Permanent link")

-   CWE-20: Improper Input Validation
    [https://cwe.mitre.org/data/definitions/20.html](https://cwe.mitre.org/data/definitions/20.html)


## Description[¶](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-CODE/SCWE-154/#description "Permanent link")

Decoding calldata or bytes with `abi.decode` without first verifying the input length can cause unexpected reverts. In modern Solidity (0.4.22+), `abi.decode` with data shorter than expected reverts due to bounds checking; malformed or incorrectly typed data can produce wrong values. SCWE-122 covers calldata length validation; this weakness addresses the broader pattern of decoding without length checks.


## Remediation[¶](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-CODE/SCWE-154/#remediation "Permanent link")

-   Validate `data.length >= expectedLength` before `abi.decode`.
-   Use `abi.decode` with the correct type and ensure the encoded data matches.


## Examples[¶](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-CODE/SCWE-154/#examples "Permanent link")


### Vulnerable[¶](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-CODE/SCWE-154/#vulnerable "Permanent link")

`[](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-CODE/SCWE-154/#__codelineno-0-1)pragma solidity ^0.8.0; [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-CODE/SCWE-154/#__codelineno-0-2)[](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-CODE/SCWE-154/#__codelineno-0-3)contract Decoder {     [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-CODE/SCWE-154/#__codelineno-0-4)    function decodeAndUse(bytes calldata data) external {        [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-CODE/SCWE-154/#__codelineno-0-5)        (address recipient, uint256 amount) = abi.decode(data, (address, uint256));        [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-CODE/SCWE-154/#__codelineno-0-6)        // If data is too short, decode reverts; malformed data can produce wrong values        [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-CODE/SCWE-154/#__codelineno-0-7)        transfer(recipient, amount);    [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-CODE/SCWE-154/#__codelineno-0-8)    } [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-CODE/SCWE-154/#__codelineno-0-9)}`


### Fixed[¶](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-CODE/SCWE-154/#fixed "Permanent link")

`[](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-CODE/SCWE-154/#__codelineno-1-1)function decodeAndUse(bytes calldata data) external {     [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-CODE/SCWE-154/#__codelineno-1-2)    require(data.length >= 32 + 32, "Invalid data length");    [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-CODE/SCWE-154/#__codelineno-1-3)    (address recipient, uint256 amount) = abi.decode(data, (address, uint256));    [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-CODE/SCWE-154/#__codelineno-1-4)    transfer(recipient, amount); [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-CODE/SCWE-154/#__codelineno-1-5)}`

# SCWE-021: Unsecured Data Transmission

Stable Version v1.0

This content is in the **version-(v1.0)** and still under active development, so it is subject to change any time (e.g. structure, IDs, content, URLs, etc.).

[Send Feedback](https://github.com/OWASP/www-project-smart-contract-security-testing-guide/discussions/categories/scwe-scstg-v2-beta-feedback)


## Relationships[¶](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-COMM/SCWE-021/#relationships "Permanent link")

-   CWE-319: Cleartext Transmission of Sensitive Information
    [CWE-319 Link](https://cwe.mitre.org/data/definitions/319.html)


## Description[¶](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-COMM/SCWE-021/#description "Permanent link")

Unsecured data transmission refers to the transmission of sensitive information, such as private keys or user data, without encryption. This can lead to: - Interception of sensitive data by malicious actors. - Exploitation of vulnerabilities in the contract. - Loss of funds or data.


## Remediation[¶](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-COMM/SCWE-021/#remediation "Permanent link")

-   **Use encryption:** Encrypt sensitive data before transmission.
-   **Leverage secure protocols:** Use HTTPS or other secure communication protocols.
-   **Avoid transmitting sensitive data:** Minimize the transmission of sensitive data whenever possible.


## Examples[¶](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-COMM/SCWE-021/#examples "Permanent link")

-   **Unsecured Data Transmission**

    `[](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-COMM/SCWE-021/#__codelineno-0-1)pragma solidity ^0.8.0; [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-COMM/SCWE-021/#__codelineno-0-2)[](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-COMM/SCWE-021/#__codelineno-0-3)contract UnsecuredData {     [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-COMM/SCWE-021/#__codelineno-0-4)    function transmitData(bytes memory data) public {        [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-COMM/SCWE-021/#__codelineno-0-5)        // Transmit data without encryption    [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-COMM/SCWE-021/#__codelineno-0-6)    } [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-COMM/SCWE-021/#__codelineno-0-7)}`

-   **Secured Data Transmission**

    `[](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-COMM/SCWE-021/#__codelineno-1-1)pragma solidity ^0.8.0; [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-COMM/SCWE-021/#__codelineno-1-2)[](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-COMM/SCWE-021/#__codelineno-1-3)contract SecuredData {     [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-COMM/SCWE-021/#__codelineno-1-4)    function transmitData(bytes memory encryptedData) public {        [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-COMM/SCWE-021/#__codelineno-1-5)        // Transmit encrypted data    [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-COMM/SCWE-021/#__codelineno-1-6)    } [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-COMM/SCWE-021/#__codelineno-1-7)}`

# SCWE-022: Message Replay Vulnerabilities

Stable Version v1.0

This content is in the **version-(v1.0)** and still under active development, so it is subject to change any time (e.g. structure, IDs, content, URLs, etc.).

[Send Feedback](https://github.com/OWASP/www-project-smart-contract-security-testing-guide/discussions/categories/scwe-scstg-v2-beta-feedback)


## Relationships[¶](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-COMM/SCWE-022/#relationships "Permanent link")

-   CWE-294: Authentication Bypass by Capture-replay
    [CWE-294 Link](https://cwe.mitre.org/data/definitions/294.html)


## Description[¶](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-COMM/SCWE-022/#description "Permanent link")

Message replay vulnerabilities occur when an attacker can reuse a valid message or transaction to perform unauthorized actions. This can lead to: - Unauthorized access to sensitive functions. - Loss of funds or data. - Exploitation of the contract's logic.


## Remediation[¶](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-COMM/SCWE-022/#remediation "Permanent link")

-   **Use nonces:** Include a unique nonce in each message to prevent reuse.
-   **Validate timestamps:** Ensure messages are only valid for a limited time.
-   **Implement replay protection:** Use established libraries or mechanisms to prevent replay attacks.


## Examples[¶](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-COMM/SCWE-022/#examples "Permanent link")

-   **Vulnerable to Replay Attacks**

    `[](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-COMM/SCWE-022/#__codelineno-0-1)pragma solidity ^0.8.0; [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-COMM/SCWE-022/#__codelineno-0-2)[](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-COMM/SCWE-022/#__codelineno-0-3)contract ReplayVulnerable {     [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-COMM/SCWE-022/#__codelineno-0-4)    function processMessage(bytes memory message) public {        [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-COMM/SCWE-022/#__codelineno-0-5)        // Process message without replay protection    [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-COMM/SCWE-022/#__codelineno-0-6)    } [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-COMM/SCWE-022/#__codelineno-0-7)}`

-   **Protected Against Replay Attacks**

    `[](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-COMM/SCWE-022/#__codelineno-1-1)pragma solidity ^0.8.0; [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-COMM/SCWE-022/#__codelineno-1-2)[](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-COMM/SCWE-022/#__codelineno-1-3)contract ReplayProtected {     [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-COMM/SCWE-022/#__codelineno-1-4)    mapping(bytes32 => bool) public usedMessages; [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-COMM/SCWE-022/#__codelineno-1-5)    [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-COMM/SCWE-022/#__codelineno-1-6)    function processMessage(bytes memory message, uint nonce, uint chainId) public {        [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-COMM/SCWE-022/#__codelineno-1-7)        bytes32 messageHash = keccak256(abi.encodePacked(message, nonce, chainId));        [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-COMM/SCWE-022/#__codelineno-1-8)        require(!usedMessages[messageHash], "Message already used");        [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-COMM/SCWE-022/#__codelineno-1-9)        usedMessages[messageHash] = true;        [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-COMM/SCWE-022/#__codelineno-1-10)        // Process message    [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-COMM/SCWE-022/#__codelineno-1-11)    } [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-COMM/SCWE-022/#__codelineno-1-12)}`

Stable Version v1.0

[Send Feedback](https://github.com/OWASP/www-project-smart-contract-security-testing-guide/discussions/categories/scwe-scstg-v2-beta-feedback)

-   CWE-20: Improper Input Validation
    [CWE-20 Link](https://cwe.mitre.org/data/definitions/20.html)


## Description[¶](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-COMM/SCWE-023/#description "Permanent link")

Lack of communication authenticity refers to the failure to verify the authenticity of messages or transactions. This can lead to: - Unauthorized actions by malicious actors. - Loss of funds or data. - Exploitation of the contract's logic.


## Remediation[¶](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-COMM/SCWE-023/#remediation "Permanent link")

-   **Use signatures:** Require signed messages for critical actions.
-   **Validate inputs:** Ensure all messages are properly validated before processing.
-   **Implement secure communication:** Use secure protocols and libraries for communication.


## Examples[¶](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-COMM/SCWE-023/#examples "Permanent link")

-   **Lack of Authenticity**

    `[](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-COMM/SCWE-023/#__codelineno-0-1)pragma solidity ^0.8.0; [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-COMM/SCWE-023/#__codelineno-0-2)[](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-COMM/SCWE-023/#__codelineno-0-3)contract NoAuthenticity {     [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-COMM/SCWE-023/#__codelineno-0-4)    function processMessage(bytes memory message) public {        [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-COMM/SCWE-023/#__codelineno-0-5)        // Process message without authenticity check    [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-COMM/SCWE-023/#__codelineno-0-6)    } [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-COMM/SCWE-023/#__codelineno-0-7)}`

-   **Authentic Communication**

    `[](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-COMM/SCWE-023/#__codelineno-1-1)pragma solidity ^0.8.0; [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-COMM/SCWE-023/#__codelineno-1-2)[](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-COMM/SCWE-023/#__codelineno-1-3)import "@openzeppelin/contracts/utils/cryptography/ECDSA.sol"; [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-COMM/SCWE-023/#__codelineno-1-4)[](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-COMM/SCWE-023/#__codelineno-1-5)contract AuthenticCommunication {     [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-COMM/SCWE-023/#__codelineno-1-6)    using ECDSA for bytes32; [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-COMM/SCWE-023/#__codelineno-1-7)    [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-COMM/SCWE-023/#__codelineno-1-8)    function processMessage(bytes memory message, bytes memory signature) public {        [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-COMM/SCWE-023/#__codelineno-1-9)        bytes32 messageHash = keccak256(message);        [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-COMM/SCWE-023/#__codelineno-1-10)        address signer = messageHash.recover(signature);        [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-COMM/SCWE-023/#__codelineno-1-11)        require(signer == msg.sender, "Invalid signature");        [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-COMM/SCWE-023/#__codelineno-1-12)        // Process message    [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-COMM/SCWE-023/#__codelineno-1-13)    } [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-COMM/SCWE-023/#__codelineno-1-14)}`

# SCWE-035: Insecure Delegatecall Usage

Stable Version v1.0

This content is in the **version-(v1.0)** and still under active development, so it is subject to change any time (e.g. structure, IDs, content, URLs, etc.).

[Send Feedback](https://github.com/OWASP/www-project-smart-contract-security-testing-guide/discussions/categories/scwe-scstg-v2-beta-feedback)


## Relationships[¶](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-COMM/SCWE-035/#relationships "Permanent link")

-   CWE-250: Execution with Unnecessary Privileges
    [CWE-250 Link](https://cwe.mitre.org/data/definitions/250.html)


## Description[¶](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-COMM/SCWE-035/#description "Permanent link")

Insecure delegatecall usage refers to vulnerabilities that arise when using `delegatecall` to execute code from another contract. This can lead to: - Unauthorized access to sensitive functions. - Exploitation of vulnerabilities in the called contract. - Loss of funds or data.


## Remediation[¶](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-COMM/SCWE-035/#remediation "Permanent link")

-   **Validate targets:** Ensure the target contract is trusted and secure.
-   **Restrict permissions:** Restrict `delegatecall` usage to trusted addresses.
-   **Test thoroughly:** Conduct extensive testing to ensure `delegatecall` is used securely.

title: SCWE-035: Insecure Delegatecall Usage
heading: Examples[¶](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-COMM/SCWE-035/#examples "Permanent link")
text:
## Examples[¶](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-COMM/SCWE-035/#examples "Permanent link")

-   **Insecure Delegatecall Usage**

    `[](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-COMM/SCWE-035/#__codelineno-0-1)pragma solidity ^0.8.0; [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-COMM/SCWE-035/#__codelineno-0-2)[](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-COMM/SCWE-035/#__codelineno-0-3)contract InsecureDelegatecall {     [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-COMM/SCWE-035/#__codelineno-0-4)    function executeDelegatecall(address target, bytes memory data) public {        [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-COMM/SCWE-035/#__codelineno-0-5)        (bool success, ) = target.delegatecall(data); // ❌ No validation, attacker-controlled contract can be used        [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-COMM/SCWE-035/#__codelineno-0-6)        require(success, "Delegatecall failed");    [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-COMM/SCWE-035/#__codelineno-0-7)    } [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-COMM/SCWE-035/#__codelineno-0-8)}`

-   Anyone can call `executeDelegatecall()` with a malicious contract, which will execute arbitrary code within the caller’s context.
-   Can lead to theft of funds, privilege escalation, or state corruption.

-   **Secure Delegatecall Usage**

    `[](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-COMM/SCWE-035/#__codelineno-1-1)pragma solidity ^0.8.0; [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-COMM/SCWE-035/#__codelineno-1-2)[](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-COMM/SCWE-035/#__codelineno-1-3)contract SecureDelegatecall {     [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-COMM/SCWE-035/#__codelineno-1-4)    address public owner;        [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-COMM/SCWE-035/#__codelineno-1-14)        trustedTarget = _trustedTarget;    [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-COMM/SCWE-035/#__codelineno-1-15)    } [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-COMM/SCWE-035/#__codelineno-1-16)    [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-COMM/SCWE-035/#__codelineno-1-17)    function updateTrustedTarget(address _newTarget) public onlyOwner {        [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-COMM/SCWE-035/#__codelineno-1-18)        require(isTrusted(_newTarget), "Untrusted target"); # SCWE-042: Insecure Use of External Calls

Stable Version v1.0

This content is in the **version-(v1.0)** and still under active development, so it is subject to change any time (e.g. structure, IDs, content, URLs, etc.).

[Send Feedback](https://github.com/OWASP/www-project-smart-contract-security-testing-guide/discussions/categories/scwe-scstg-v2-beta-feedback)


## Relationships[¶](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-COMM/SCWE-042/#relationships "Permanent link")

-   CWE-829: Inclusion of Functionality from Untrusted Control Sphere
    [CWE-829 Link](https://cwe.mitre.org/data/definitions/829.html)


## Description[¶](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-COMM/SCWE-042/#description "Permanent link")

Insecure use of external calls refers to vulnerabilities that arise when calling external contracts without proper validation or safeguards. This can lead to: - Unauthorized actions by malicious actors. - Loss of funds or data. - Exploitation of vulnerabilities in the called contract.


## Remediation[¶](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-COMM/SCWE-042/#remediation "Permanent link")

-   **Validate targets:** Ensure the target contract is trusted and secure.
-   **Use secure libraries:** Leverage well-audited libraries for external calls.
-   **Test thoroughly:** Conduct extensive testing to ensure external calls are secure.

title: SCWE-042: Insecure Use of External Calls
heading: Examples[¶](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-COMM/SCWE-042/#examples "Permanent link")
text:
## Examples[¶](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-COMM/SCWE-042/#examples "Permanent link")

-   **Insecure External Call**

    `[](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-COMM/SCWE-042/#__codelineno-0-1)pragma solidity ^0.8.0; [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-COMM/SCWE-042/#__codelineno-0-2)[](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-COMM/SCWE-042/#__codelineno-0-3)contract InsecureExternalCall {     [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-COMM/SCWE-042/#__codelineno-0-4)    function callExternal(address target, bytes memory data) public {        [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-COMM/SCWE-042/#__codelineno-0-5)        (bool success, ) = target.call(data); // No validation        [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-COMM/SCWE-042/#__codelineno-0-6)        require(success, "Call failed");    [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-COMM/SCWE-042/#__codelineno-0-7)    } [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-COMM/SCWE-042/#__codelineno-0-8)}`

-   **Secure External Call**

    `[](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-COMM/SCWE-042/#__codelineno-1-1)pragma solidity ^0.8.0; [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-COMM/SCWE-042/#__codelineno-1-2)[](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-COMM/SCWE-042/#__codelineno-1-3)interface ITrustedContract {     [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-COMM/SCWE-042/#__codelineno-1-4)    function executeAction(uint256 param) external; [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-COMM/SCWE-042/#__codelineno-1-5)} [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-COMM/SCWE-042/#__codelineno-1-6)[](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-COMM/SCWE-042/#__codelineno-1-7)contract SecureExternalCall {     [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-COMM/SCWE-042/#__codelineno-1-8)    address public immutable trustedTarget;    [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-COMM/SCWE-042/#__codelineno-1-9)    address public owner; [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-COMM/SCWE-042/#__codelineno-1-10)    [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-COMM/SCWE-042/#__codelineno-1-11)    constructor(address _trustedTarget) {        [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-COMM/SCWE-042/#__codelineno-1-12)        trustedTarget = _trustedTarget;        [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-COMM/SCWE-042/#__codelineno-1-13)        owner = msg.sender;    [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-COMM/SCWE-042/#__codelineno-1-14)    } [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-COMM/SCWE-042/#__codelineno-1-15)    [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-COMM/SCWE-042/#__codelineno-1-16)    modifier onlyOwner() {        [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-COMM/SCWE-042/#__codelineno-1-17)        require(msg.sender == owner, "Unauthorized");        [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-COMM/SCWE-042/#__codelineno-1-18)        _;    [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-COMM/SCWE-042/#__codelineno-1-19)    } [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-COMM/SCWE-042/#__codelineno-1-20)    [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-COMM/SCWE-042/#__codelineno-1-21)    function callExternal(uint256 param) public onlyOwner {        [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-COMM/SCWE-042/#__codelineno-1-22)        ITrustedContract(trustedTarget).executeAction(param);    [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-COMM/SCWE-042/#__codelineno-1-23)    } [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-COMM/SCWE-042/#__codelineno-1-24)}`

    Why is this secure?

-   No arbitrary data input—Only predefined `function executeAction(uint256)` can be called.
-   Access control added—Only the owner can execute external calls.
-   Interface-based call—Avoids raw `.call()`, reducing attack vectors.
-   Immutable trusted address—Prevents runtime modifications to the target contract.

# SCWE-063: Insecure Event Emission

Stable Version v1.0

This content is in the **version-(v1.0)** and still under active development, so it is subject to change any time (e.g. structure, IDs, content, URLs, etc.).

[Send Feedback](https://github.com/OWASP/www-project-smart-contract-security-testing-guide/discussions/categories/scwe-scstg-v2-beta-feedback)


## Relationships[¶](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-COMM/SCWE-063/#relationships "Permanent link")

-   CWE-778: Insufficient Logging
    [https://cwe.mitre.org/data/definitions/778.html](https://cwe.mitre.org/data/definitions/778.html)


## Description[¶](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-COMM/SCWE-063/#description "Permanent link")

Events in Solidity play a critical role in logging contract activity and ensuring transparency. Improper event handling can lead to security risks such as:

1.  **Missing critical event emissions** – Making external monitoring difficult.
2.  **Emitting misleading or incorrect data** – Resulting in users or external systems making incorrect assumptions.
3.  **Logging sensitive information** – Leaking private or security-sensitive data.

Failure to handle events properly can affect contract auditing, debugging, and external monitoring tools, making it difficult to detect anomalies or track contract states correctly.


## Remediation[¶](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-COMM/SCWE-063/#remediation "Permanent link")

-   Emit events for all critical state changes, such as token transfers, ownership changes, or contract upgrades.
-   Ensure that the data logged in events accurately represents the actual contract state.
-   Avoid logging sensitive information such as private keys, hashes used for authentication, or confidential business logic.


### Vulnerable Contract Example[¶](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-COMM/SCWE-063/#vulnerable-contract-example "Permanent link")

`[](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-COMM/SCWE-063/#__codelineno-0-1)contract Example {     [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-COMM/SCWE-063/#__codelineno-0-2)    mapping(address => uint) public balances;    [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-COMM/SCWE-063/#__codelineno-0-3)    event Withdraw(address indexed user, uint amount); [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-COMM/SCWE-063/#__codelineno-0-4)    [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-COMM/SCWE-063/#__codelineno-0-5)    function deposit() public payable {        [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-COMM/SCWE-063/#__codelineno-0-6)        balances[msg.sender] += msg.value;    [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-COMM/SCWE-063/#__codelineno-0-7)    } [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-COMM/SCWE-063/#__codelineno-0-8)    [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-COMM/SCWE-063/#__codelineno-0-9)    function withdraw(uint _amount) public {        [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-COMM/SCWE-063/#__codelineno-0-10)        require(balances[msg.sender] >= _amount, "Insufficient funds");        [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-COMM/SCWE-063/#__codelineno-0-11)        payable(msg.sender).transfer(_amount);        [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-COMM/SCWE-063/#__codelineno-0-12)        balances[msg.sender] -= _amount; [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-COMM/SCWE-063/#__codelineno-0-13)        [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-COMM/SCWE-063/#__codelineno-0-14)        // Incorrect event emission: Logs the requested amount instead of the actual withdrawn amount        [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-COMM/SCWE-063/#__codelineno-0-15)        emit Withdraw(msg.sender, _amount);    [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-COMM/SCWE-063/#__codelineno-0-16)    } [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-COMM/SCWE-063/#__codelineno-0-17)}`

title: SCWE-063: Insecure Event Emission
heading: Fixes in the Secure Code[¶](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-COMM/SCWE-063/#fixes-in-the-secure-code "Permanent link")
text:
### Issues in the Vulnerable Code[¶](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-COMM/SCWE-063/#issues-in-the-vulnerable-code "Permanent link")

-   The Withdraw event logs `_amount`, which is the requested `withdrawal` amount, but if the transfer fails (due to gas limits, reentrancy, or an external issue), the event still logs it as if the withdrawal happened.
-   If an attacker exploits a discrepancy between event logs and actual state changes, they could mislead users, external indexers, or off-chain services.


### Fixed Contract Example[¶](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-COMM/SCWE-063/#fixed-contract-example "Permanent link")

`[](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-COMM/SCWE-063/#__codelineno-1-1)contract Example {     [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-COMM/SCWE-063/#__codelineno-1-2)    mapping(address => uint) public balances;    [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-COMM/SCWE-063/#__codelineno-1-3)    event Withdraw(address indexed user, uint actualAmount); [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-COMM/SCWE-063/#__codelineno-1-4)    [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-COMM/SCWE-063/#__codelineno-1-5)    function deposit() public payable {        [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-COMM/SCWE-063/#__codelineno-1-6)        balances[msg.sender] += msg.value;    [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-COMM/SCWE-063/#__codelineno-1-7)    } [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-COMM/SCWE-063/#__codelineno-1-8)    [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-COMM/SCWE-063/#__codelineno-1-9)    function withdraw(uint _amount) public {        [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-COMM/SCWE-063/#__codelineno-1-10)        require(balances[msg.sender] >= _amount, "Insufficient funds"); [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-COMM/SCWE-063/#__codelineno-1-11)        [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-COMM/SCWE-063/#__codelineno-1-12)        (bool success, ) = payable(msg.sender).call{value: _amount}("");        [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-COMM/SCWE-063/#__codelineno-1-13)        require(success, "Transfer failed"); [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-COMM/SCWE-063/#__codelineno-1-14)        [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-COMM/SCWE-063/#__codelineno-1-15)        balances[msg.sender] -= _amount; [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-COMM/SCWE-063/#__codelineno-1-16)        [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-COMM/SCWE-063/#__codelineno-1-17)        // Logs the amount actually withdrawn (equals _amount on success)        [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-COMM/SCWE-063/#__codelineno-1-18)        emit Withdraw(msg.sender, _amount);    [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-COMM/SCWE-063/#__codelineno-1-19)    } [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-COMM/SCWE-063/#__codelineno-1-20)}`


### Fixes in the Secure Code[¶](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-COMM/SCWE-063/#fixes-in-the-secure-code "Permanent link")

-   Uses `call{value: _amount}("")` to send funds safely and ensures success before updating the balance.
-   Updates state and emits the event only after a successful transfer; logs `_amount` (the actual withdrawn amount on success).
-   Prevents false event emissions by reverting on transfer failure before any state change or event.

title: SCWE-103: ERC20 Approval Double-Spend (Allowance Race)
heading: Fixed[¶](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-COMM/SCWE-103/#fixed "Permanent link")
text:
*Last updated: August 19, 2026*



# SCWE-103: ERC20 Approval Double-Spend (Allowance Race)

Stable Version v1.0

This content is in the **version-(v1.0)** and still under active development, so it is subject to change any time (e.g. structure, IDs, content, URLs, etc.).

[Send Feedback](https://github.com/OWASP/www-project-smart-contract-security-testing-guide/discussions/categories/scwe-scstg-v2-beta-feedback)


## Relationships[¶](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-COMM/SCWE-103/#relationships "Permanent link")

-   CWE-362: Concurrent Execution using Shared Resource with Improper Synchronization (Race Condition)
    [https://cwe.mitre.org/data/definitions/362.html](https://cwe.mitre.org/data/definitions/362.html)


## Description[¶](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-COMM/SCWE-103/#description "Permanent link")

Changing an ERC20 allowance from value `X` to `Y` with a single `approve` call allows a spender to front-run and spend `X` before the change, then spend `Y` after, effectively double-spending. Integrations that do not use `increaseAllowance`/`decreaseAllowance` are exposed.


## Remediation[¶](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-COMM/SCWE-103/#remediation "Permanent link")

-   Follow the allowance reset pattern: set allowance to `0`, then set the new value.
-   Prefer `increaseAllowance`/`decreaseAllowance` or EIP-2612 `permit` with nonces.
-   For critical flows, pull tokens via `transferFrom` after verifying allowance updates.


## Examples[¶](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-COMM/SCWE-103/#examples "Permanent link")


### Vulnerable[¶](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-COMM/SCWE-103/#vulnerable "Permanent link")

`[](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-COMM/SCWE-103/#__codelineno-0-1)pragma solidity ^0.8.0; [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-COMM/SCWE-103/#__codelineno-0-2)interface IERC20 { function approve(address,uint256) external returns (bool); } [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-COMM/SCWE-103/#__codelineno-0-3)[](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-COMM/SCWE-103/#__codelineno-0-4)contract DApp {     [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-COMM/SCWE-103/#__codelineno-0-5)    IERC20 public token; [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-COMM/SCWE-103/#__codelineno-0-6)    [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-COMM/SCWE-103/#__codelineno-0-7)    function changeSpender(address spender, uint256 newAmount) external {        [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-COMM/SCWE-103/#__codelineno-0-8)        token.approve(spender, newAmount); // can be front-run    [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-COMM/SCWE-103/#__codelineno-0-9)    } [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-COMM/SCWE-103/#__codelineno-0-10)}`


### Fixed[¶](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-COMM/SCWE-103/#fixed "Permanent link")

`[](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-COMM/SCWE-103/#__codelineno-1-1)pragma solidity ^0.8.0; [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-COMM/SCWE-103/#__codelineno-1-2)import "@openzeppelin/contracts/token/ERC20/IERC20.sol"; [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-COMM/SCWE-103/#__codelineno-1-3)import "@openzeppelin/contracts/token/ERC20/utils/SafeERC20.sol"; [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-COMM/SCWE-103/#__codelineno-1-4)[](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-COMM/SCWE-103/#__codelineno-1-5)contract DApp {     [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-COMM/SCWE-103/#__codelineno-1-6)    using SafeERC20 for IERC20;    [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-COMM/SCWE-103/#__codelineno-1-7)    IERC20 public token; [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-COMM/SCWE-103/#__codelineno-1-8)    [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-COMM/SCWE-103/#__codelineno-1-9)    function changeSpender(address spender, uint256 newAmount) external {        [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-COMM/SCWE-103/#__codelineno-1-10)        token.safeApprove(spender, 0);      // reset first; SafeERC20 handles non-standard tokens (e.g. USDT)        [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-COMM/SCWE-103/#__codelineno-1-11)        token.safeApprove(spender, newAmount);    [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-COMM/SCWE-103/#__codelineno-1-12)    } [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-COMM/SCWE-103/#__codelineno-1-13)}`

## Relationships[¶](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-COMM/SCWE-104/#relationships "Permanent link")

-   CWE-841: Improper Enforcement of Behavioral Workflow
    [https://cwe.mitre.org/data/definitions/841.html](https://cwe.mitre.org/data/definitions/841.html)


## Description[¶](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-COMM/SCWE-104/#description "Permanent link")

ERC777 tokens trigger `tokensReceived` hooks on recipients. Contracts that accept tokens without reentrancy protection or without blocking ERC777 hooks can be reentered during token transfers, enabling double-withdrawals or bypassing invariants.


## Remediation[¶](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-COMM/SCWE-104/#remediation "Permanent link")

-   Add `nonReentrant` guards around token transfer handlers and withdrawals.
-   Block unexpected token types or disable ERC777 acceptance by rejecting the ERC1820 interface.
-   Use pull-based withdrawals and avoid performing sensitive logic inside token receive hooks.


## Examples[¶](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-COMM/SCWE-104/#examples "Permanent link")


### Vulnerable[¶](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-COMM/SCWE-104/#vulnerable "Permanent link")

`[](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-COMM/SCWE-104/#__codelineno-0-1)pragma solidity ^0.8.0; [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-COMM/SCWE-104/#__codelineno-0-2)interface IERC777 { function send(address,uint256,bytes calldata) external; } [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-COMM/SCWE-104/#__codelineno-0-3)[](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-COMM/SCWE-104/#__codelineno-0-4)contract Rewards {     [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-COMM/SCWE-104/#__codelineno-0-5)    uint256 public totalPaid; [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-COMM/SCWE-104/#__codelineno-0-6)    [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-COMM/SCWE-104/#__codelineno-0-7)    function claim(address token, uint256 amount) external {        [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-COMM/SCWE-104/#__codelineno-0-8)        IERC777(token).send(msg.sender, amount, ""); // ERC777 hook can reenter        [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-COMM/SCWE-104/#__codelineno-0-9)        totalPaid += amount;    [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-COMM/SCWE-104/#__codelineno-0-10)    } [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-COMM/SCWE-104/#__codelineno-0-11)}`

# SCWE-107: Missing Chain ID Validation in Cross-Chain Messages

Stable Version v1.0

This content is in the **version-(v1.0)** and still under active development, so it is subject to change any time (e.g. structure, IDs, content, URLs, etc.).

[Send Feedback](https://github.com/OWASP/www-project-smart-contract-security-testing-guide/discussions/categories/scwe-scstg-v2-beta-feedback)


## Relationships[¶](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-COMM/SCWE-107/#relationships "Permanent link")

-   CWE-345: Insufficient Verification of Data Authenticity
    [https://cwe.mitre.org/data/definitions/345.html](https://cwe.mitre.org/data/definitions/345.html)


## Description[¶](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-COMM/SCWE-107/#description "Permanent link")

Cross-chain handlers that accept payloads without checking the source `chainId` or endpoint domain allow replay of messages from other networks or forks. Attackers can re-trigger transfers, minting, or governance actions on unintended chains.


## Remediation[¶](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-COMM/SCWE-107/#remediation "Permanent link")

-   Bind every inbound message to an expected source chain/domain and trusted sender.
-   Include `chainId`/domain separators in signed payloads and verify them before execution.
-   Maintain replay protection (nonces) per (sourceChain, sourceSender).


## Examples[¶](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-COMM/SCWE-107/#examples "Permanent link")


### Vulnerable[¶](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-COMM/SCWE-107/#vulnerable "Permanent link")

`[](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-COMM/SCWE-107/#__codelineno-0-1)pragma solidity ^0.8.0; [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-COMM/SCWE-107/#__codelineno-0-2)[](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-COMM/SCWE-107/#__codelineno-0-3)contract BridgeReceiver {     [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-COMM/SCWE-107/#__codelineno-0-4)    function receiveMessage(bytes calldata data) external {        [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-COMM/SCWE-107/#__codelineno-0-5)        _execute(data); // no chainId/source validation    [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-COMM/SCWE-107/#__codelineno-0-6)    } [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-COMM/SCWE-107/#__codelineno-0-7)}`


### Fixed[¶](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-COMM/SCWE-107/#fixed "Permanent link")

`[](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-COMM/SCWE-107/#__codelineno-1-1)pragma solidity ^0.8.0; [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-COMM/SCWE-107/#__codelineno-1-2)[](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-COMM/SCWE-107/#__codelineno-1-3)contract BridgeReceiver {     [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-COMM/SCWE-107/#__codelineno-1-4)    mapping(uint256 => mapping(address => uint256)) public nonce; // per (chainId, sender)    [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-COMM/SCWE-107/#__codelineno-1-5)    address public trustedSender;    [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-COMM/SCWE-107/#__codelineno-1-6)    uint256 public trustedChainId; [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-COMM/SCWE-107/#__codelineno-1-7)    [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-COMM/SCWE-107/#__codelineno-1-8)    function receiveMessage(uint256 srcChainId, address src, uint256 n, bytes calldata data) external {        [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-COMM/SCWE-107/#__codelineno-1-9)        require(srcChainId == trustedChainId && src == trustedSender, "unauthorized source");        [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-COMM/SCWE-107/#__codelineno-1-10)        require(n == nonce[srcChainId][src]++, "replay");        [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-COMM/SCWE-107/#__codelineno-1-11)        _execute(data);    [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-COMM/SCWE-107/#__codelineno-1-12)    } [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-COMM/SCWE-107/#__codelineno-1-13)}`

# SCWE-108: Unverified Cross-Chain Message Proofs

Stable Version v1.0

This content is in the **version-(v1.0)** and still under active development, so it is subject to change any time (e.g. structure, IDs, content, URLs, etc.).

[Send Feedback](https://github.com/OWASP/www-project-smart-contract-security-testing-guide/discussions/categories/scwe-scstg-v2-beta-feedback)


## Relationships[¶](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-COMM/SCWE-108/#relationships "Permanent link")

-   CWE-345: Insufficient Verification of Data Authenticity
    [https://cwe.mitre.org/data/definitions/345.html](https://cwe.mitre.org/data/definitions/345.html)


## Description[¶](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-COMM/SCWE-108/#description "Permanent link")

Relayers may deliver fabricated payloads if the destination contract does not validate Merkle proofs, light-client headers, or signatures that attest to the message on the source chain. Forged messages can mint wrapped assets or execute arbitrary calls.


## Remediation[¶](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-COMM/SCWE-108/#remediation "Permanent link")

-   Verify message inclusion against a trusted root (Merkle/Patricia proof) or light-client header.
-   Validate signatures from authorized validators and enforce quorum thresholds.
-   Reject messages that fail proof verification or originate from unrecognized relayers.


## Examples[¶](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-COMM/SCWE-108/#examples "Permanent link")


### Vulnerable[¶](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-COMM/SCWE-108/#vulnerable "Permanent link")

`[](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-COMM/SCWE-108/#__codelineno-0-1)pragma solidity ^0.8.0; [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-COMM/SCWE-108/#__codelineno-0-2)[](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-COMM/SCWE-108/#__codelineno-0-3)contract Inbox {     [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-COMM/SCWE-108/#__codelineno-0-4)    function deliver(bytes calldata payload) external {        [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-COMM/SCWE-108/#__codelineno-0-5)        _process(payload); // assumes relayer is honest    [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-COMM/SCWE-108/#__codelineno-0-6)    } [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-COMM/SCWE-108/#__codelineno-0-7)}`


### Fixed[¶](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-COMM/SCWE-108/#fixed "Permanent link")

`[](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-COMM/SCWE-108/#__codelineno-1-1)pragma solidity ^0.8.0; [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-COMM/SCWE-108/#__codelineno-1-2)[](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-COMM/SCWE-108/#__codelineno-1-3)contract Inbox {     [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-COMM/SCWE-108/#__codelineno-1-4)    address[] public validators;    [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-COMM/SCWE-108/#__codelineno-1-5)    uint256 public constant QUORUM = 2; [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-COMM/SCWE-108/#__codelineno-1-6)    [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-COMM/SCWE-108/#__codelineno-1-7)    function deliver(bytes calldata payload, bytes[] calldata sigs) external {        [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-COMM/SCWE-108/#__codelineno-1-8)        require(_verifyQuorum(payload, sigs) >= QUORUM, "invalid proof");        [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-COMM/SCWE-108/#__codelineno-1-9)        _process(payload);    [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-COMM/SCWE-108/#__codelineno-1-10)    } [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-COMM/SCWE-108/#__codelineno-1-11)}`
