# SCWE-100: Missing Quorum Validation in Governance Execution

Stable Version v1.0

This content is in the **version-(v1.0)** and still under active development, so it is subject to change any time (e.g. structure, IDs, content, URLs, etc.).

[Send Feedback](https://github.com/OWASP/www-project-smart-contract-security-testing-guide/discussions/categories/scwe-scstg-v2-beta-feedback)


## Relationships[¶](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-GOV/SCWE-100/#relationships "Permanent link")

-   CWE-754: Improper Check for Unusual or Exceptional Conditions
    [https://cwe.mitre.org/data/definitions/754.html](https://cwe.mitre.org/data/definitions/754.html)


## Description[¶](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-GOV/SCWE-100/#description "Permanent link")

Governance systems that allow proposal execution based solely on vote counts (e.g., "for" > "against") without enforcing a minimum participation threshold (quorum) can execute proposals with negligible community participation. A proposal may "pass" with only a handful of votes if quorum is not checked, allowing a small group or attacker with accumulated tokens to push through changes that lack legitimate community mandate.


## Remediation[¶](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-GOV/SCWE-100/#remediation "Permanent link")

-   Enforce a minimum quorum (e.g., percentage of total supply or voting power) before allowing execution.
-   Require both vote majority and quorum to be satisfied; revert execution if quorum is not met.
-   Consider time-weighted or participation-based quorum to prevent last-block manipulation.


## Examples[¶](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-GOV/SCWE-100/#examples "Permanent link")


### Vulnerable[¶](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-GOV/SCWE-100/#vulnerable "Permanent link")

`[](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-GOV/SCWE-100/#__codelineno-0-1)pragma solidity ^0.8.0; [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-GOV/SCWE-100/#__codelineno-0-2)[](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-GOV/SCWE-100/#__codelineno-0-3)contract VulnerableGov {     [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-GOV/SCWE-100/#__codelineno-0-4)    mapping(uint256 => uint256) public forVotes;    [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-GOV/SCWE-100/#__codelineno-0-5)    mapping(uint256 => uint256) public againstVotes;    [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-GOV/SCWE-100/#__codelineno-0-6)    uint256 public totalSupply; [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-GOV/SCWE-100/#__codelineno-0-7)    [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-GOV/SCWE-100/#__codelineno-0-8)    function execute(uint256 proposalId) external {        [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-GOV/SCWE-100/#__codelineno-0-9)        require(forVotes[proposalId] > againstVotes[proposalId], "proposal failed");        [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-GOV/SCWE-100/#__codelineno-0-10)        // No quorum check — can execute with 2 for, 1 against even if totalSupply is 1M        [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-GOV/SCWE-100/#__codelineno-0-11)        _executeProposal(proposalId);    [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-GOV/SCWE-100/#__codelineno-0-12)    } [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-GOV/SCWE-100/#__codelineno-0-13)}`

# SCWE-101: Flash-Loan-Fueled Governance Manipulation

Stable Version v1.0

This content is in the **version-(v1.0)** and still under active development, so it is subject to change any time (e.g. structure, IDs, content, URLs, etc.).

[Send Feedback](https://github.com/OWASP/www-project-smart-contract-security-testing-guide/discussions/categories/scwe-scstg-v2-beta-feedback)


## Relationships[¶](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-GOV/SCWE-101/#relationships "Permanent link")

-   CWE-367: Time-of-Check Time-of-Use (TOCTOU) Race Condition
    [https://cwe.mitre.org/data/definitions/367.html](https://cwe.mitre.org/data/definitions/367.html)


## Description[¶](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-GOV/SCWE-101/#description "Permanent link")

If voting power is measured at execution time without historical snapshots or locking, an attacker can borrow a large balance via flash loan, pass a proposal, and return the loan in the same transaction. Governance decisions then depend on transient liquidity rather than long-term stake.


## Remediation[¶](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-GOV/SCWE-101/#remediation "Permanent link")

-   Use token balance snapshots at a fixed block for voting power.
-   Require vote escrow/locking or minimum voting period spanning multiple blocks.
-   Set quorum and proposal thresholds based on historical supply, not instantaneous balances.


## Examples[¶](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-GOV/SCWE-101/#examples "Permanent link")


### Vulnerable[¶](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-GOV/SCWE-101/#vulnerable "Permanent link")

`[](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-GOV/SCWE-101/#__codelineno-0-1)pragma solidity ^0.8.0; [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-GOV/SCWE-101/#__codelineno-0-2)[](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-GOV/SCWE-101/#__codelineno-0-3)contract SimpleGov {     [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-GOV/SCWE-101/#__codelineno-0-4)    IERC20 public token;    [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-GOV/SCWE-101/#__codelineno-0-5)    mapping(uint256 => bool) public proposals; [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-GOV/SCWE-101/#__codelineno-0-6)    [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-GOV/SCWE-101/#__codelineno-0-7)    function vote(uint256 id, bool support) external {        [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-GOV/SCWE-101/#__codelineno-0-8)        require(token.balanceOf(msg.sender) > 1_000_000 ether, "low power");        [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-GOV/SCWE-101/#__codelineno-0-9)        if (support) { proposals[id] = true; }    [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-GOV/SCWE-101/#__codelineno-0-10)    } [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-GOV/SCWE-101/#__codelineno-0-11)}`

*Last updated: August 19, 2026*



# SCWE-102: Missing Checks-Effects-Interactions Pattern

Stable Version v1.0

This content is in the **version-(v1.0)** and still under active development, so it is subject to change any time (e.g. structure, IDs, content, URLs, etc.).

[Send Feedback](https://github.com/OWASP/www-project-smart-contract-security-testing-guide/discussions/categories/scwe-scstg-v2-beta-feedback)


## Relationships[¶](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-GOV/SCWE-102/#relationships "Permanent link")

-   CWE-841: Improper Enforcement of Behavioral Workflow
    [https://cwe.mitre.org/data/definitions/841.html](https://cwe.mitre.org/data/definitions/841.html)


## Description[¶](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-GOV/SCWE-102/#description "Permanent link")

Calling external contracts before updating local state breaks the checks-effects-interactions (CEI) pattern. Attackers can reenter or observe stale state to perform double-withdrawals, bypass limits, or corrupt accounting.


## Remediation[¶](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-GOV/SCWE-102/#remediation "Permanent link")

-   Perform input validation and state updates before external calls.
-   Use reentrancy guards on functions that transfer value or call untrusted contracts.
-   Prefer pull-based withdrawals to avoid pushing funds inside complex flows.


## Examples[¶](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-GOV/SCWE-102/#examples "Permanent link")


### Vulnerable[¶](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-GOV/SCWE-102/#vulnerable "Permanent link")

`[](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-GOV/SCWE-102/#__codelineno-0-1)pragma solidity ^0.8.0; [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-GOV/SCWE-102/#__codelineno-0-2)[](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-GOV/SCWE-102/#__codelineno-0-3)contract Payout {     [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-GOV/SCWE-102/#__codelineno-0-4)    mapping(address => uint256) public balances; [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-GOV/SCWE-102/#__codelineno-0-5)    [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-GOV/SCWE-102/#__codelineno-0-6)    function withdraw() external {        [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-GOV/SCWE-102/#__codelineno-0-7)        (bool ok, ) = msg.sender.call{value: balances[msg.sender]}("");        [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-GOV/SCWE-102/#__codelineno-0-8)        require(ok, "send failed");       // external call first        [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-GOV/SCWE-102/#__codelineno-0-9)        balances[msg.sender] = 0;         // state updated after    [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-GOV/SCWE-102/#__codelineno-0-10)    } [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-GOV/SCWE-102/#__codelineno-0-11)}`


### Fixed[¶](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-GOV/SCWE-102/#fixed "Permanent link")

`[](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-GOV/SCWE-102/#__codelineno-1-1)pragma solidity ^0.8.0; [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-GOV/SCWE-102/#__codelineno-1-2)import "@openzeppelin/contracts/security/ReentrancyGuard.sol"; // OZ 5.x: utils/ReentrancyGuard.sol [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-GOV/SCWE-102/#__codelineno-1-3)[](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-GOV/SCWE-102/#__codelineno-1-4)contract Payout is ReentrancyGuard {     [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-GOV/SCWE-102/#__codelineno-1-5)    mapping(address => uint256) public balances; [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-GOV/SCWE-102/#__codelineno-1-6)    [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-GOV/SCWE-102/#__codelineno-1-7)    function withdraw() external nonReentrant {        [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-GOV/SCWE-102/#__codelineno-1-8)        uint256 amount = balances[msg.sender];        [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-GOV/SCWE-102/#__codelineno-1-9)        balances[msg.sender] = 0;         // effects first        [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-GOV/SCWE-102/#__codelineno-1-10)        (bool ok, ) = msg.sender.call{value: amount}("");        [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-GOV/SCWE-102/#__codelineno-1-11)        require(ok, "send failed");       // interaction last    [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-GOV/SCWE-102/#__codelineno-1-12)    } [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-GOV/SCWE-102/#__codelineno-1-13)}`

title: SCWE-136: Unbounded Proposal Execution Gas
heading: Fixed[¶](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-GOV/SCWE-136/#fixed "Permanent link")
text:
*Last updated: August 19, 2026*



# SCWE-136: Unbounded Proposal Execution Gas

Stable Version v1.0

This content is in the **version-(v1.0)** and still under active development, so it is subject to change any time (e.g. structure, IDs, content, URLs, etc.).

[Send Feedback](https://github.com/OWASP/www-project-smart-contract-security-testing-guide/discussions/categories/scwe-scstg-v2-beta-feedback)


## Relationships[¶](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-GOV/SCWE-136/#relationships "Permanent link")

-   CWE-400: Uncontrolled Resource Consumption
    [https://cwe.mitre.org/data/definitions/400.html](https://cwe.mitre.org/data/definitions/400.html)


## Description[¶](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-GOV/SCWE-136/#description "Permanent link")

Governance proposals that execute arbitrary call lists without gas limits or batching can exceed block gas, making proposals unexecutable (DoS). Attackers can submit proposals with expensive calls to jam governance or brick queued actions.


## Remediation[¶](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-GOV/SCWE-136/#remediation "Permanent link")

-   Enforce per-call and total gas limits; split proposals into bounded batches.
-   Allow graceful skipping of failed subcalls with clear status, or pre-validate gas cost.
-   Add simulation checks before queuing and block proposals that exceed safe gas budgets.


## Examples[¶](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-GOV/SCWE-136/#examples "Permanent link")


### Vulnerable[¶](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-GOV/SCWE-136/#vulnerable "Permanent link")

`[](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-GOV/SCWE-136/#__codelineno-0-1)function execute(bytes[] calldata calls) external {     [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-GOV/SCWE-136/#__codelineno-0-2)    for (uint i; i < calls.length; i++) {        [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-GOV/SCWE-136/#__codelineno-0-3)        target.call(calls[i]); // no gas limit    [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-GOV/SCWE-136/#__codelineno-0-4)    } [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-GOV/SCWE-136/#__codelineno-0-5)}`


### Fixed[¶](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-GOV/SCWE-136/#fixed "Permanent link")

`[](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-GOV/SCWE-136/#__codelineno-1-1)function execute(bytes[] calldata calls, uint256 gasPerCall) external {     [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-GOV/SCWE-136/#__codelineno-1-2)    for (uint i; i < calls.length; i++) {        [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-GOV/SCWE-136/#__codelineno-1-3)        (bool ok,) = target.call{gas: gasPerCall}(calls[i]);        [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-GOV/SCWE-136/#__codelineno-1-4)        require(ok, "subcall failed");    [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-GOV/SCWE-136/#__codelineno-1-5)    } [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-GOV/SCWE-136/#__codelineno-1-6)}`

title: SCWE-140: Ether Locked Due to Missing Withdrawal Path
heading: Fixed[¶](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-GOV/SCWE-140/#fixed "Permanent link")
text:
*Last updated: August 19, 2026*



# SCWE-140: Ether Locked Due to Missing Withdrawal Path

Stable Version v1.0

This content is in the **version-(v1.0)** and still under active development, so it is subject to change any time (e.g. structure, IDs, content, URLs, etc.).

[Send Feedback](https://github.com/OWASP/www-project-smart-contract-security-testing-guide/discussions/categories/scwe-scstg-v2-beta-feedback)


## Relationships[¶](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-GOV/SCWE-140/#relationships "Permanent link")

-   CWE-404: Improper Resource Shutdown or Release
    [https://cwe.mitre.org/data/definitions/404.html](https://cwe.mitre.org/data/definitions/404.html)


## Description[¶](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-GOV/SCWE-140/#description "Permanent link")

Contracts can receive ETH via `receive()`, `fallback()`, `selfdestruct` from another contract, or accidental sends. If the contract has no function to withdraw or forward this ETH, the funds become permanently locked. This can occur when a contract was not designed to hold ETH, when the withdrawal function is restricted to a role that no longer exists, or when the contract lacks a rescue/withdraw mechanism for unexpected inflows.


## Remediation[¶](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-GOV/SCWE-140/#remediation "Permanent link")

-   Implement a withdrawal or rescue function for authorized roles to recover stuck ETH.
-   If the contract should not accept ETH, use `receive() external payable { revert("ETH not accepted"); }`.
-   Document how unexpected ETH (e.g., from `selfdestruct`) is handled.


## Examples[¶](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-GOV/SCWE-140/#examples "Permanent link")


### Vulnerable[¶](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-GOV/SCWE-140/#vulnerable "Permanent link")

`[](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-GOV/SCWE-140/#__codelineno-0-1)pragma solidity ^0.8.0; [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-GOV/SCWE-140/#__codelineno-0-2)[](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-GOV/SCWE-140/#__codelineno-0-3)contract TokenSale {     [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-GOV/SCWE-140/#__codelineno-0-4)    mapping(address => uint256) public balances; [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-GOV/SCWE-140/#__codelineno-0-5)    [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-GOV/SCWE-140/#__codelineno-0-6)    function buyTokens() external payable {        [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-GOV/SCWE-140/#__codelineno-0-7)        balances[msg.sender] += msg.value;    [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-GOV/SCWE-140/#__codelineno-0-8)    } [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-GOV/SCWE-140/#__codelineno-0-9)    [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-GOV/SCWE-140/#__codelineno-0-10)    function withdrawTokens() external {        [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-GOV/SCWE-140/#__codelineno-0-11)        uint256 amount = balances[msg.sender];        [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-GOV/SCWE-140/#__codelineno-0-12)        balances[msg.sender] = 0;        [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-GOV/SCWE-140/#__codelineno-0-13)        (bool ok, ) = msg.sender.call{value: amount}("");        [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-GOV/SCWE-140/#__codelineno-0-14)        require(ok, "Transfer failed");    [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-GOV/SCWE-140/#__codelineno-0-15)    } [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-GOV/SCWE-140/#__codelineno-0-16)}`

**Why vulnerable:** If ETH is sent via `selfdestruct` or a plain transfer, it increases `address(this).balance` but not any user's `balances`. That ETH cannot be withdrawn by anyone and is locked.

title: SCWE-140: Ether Locked Due to Missing Withdrawal Path
heading: Fixed[¶](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-GOV/SCWE-140/#fixed "Permanent link")
text:
### Fixed[¶](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-GOV/SCWE-140/#fixed "Permanent link")

`[](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-GOV/SCWE-140/#__codelineno-1-1)pragma solidity ^0.8.0; [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-GOV/SCWE-140/#__codelineno-1-2)[](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-GOV/SCWE-140/#__codelineno-1-3)contract TokenSale {     [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-GOV/SCWE-140/#__codelineno-1-4)    address public owner;    [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-GOV/SCWE-140/#__codelineno-1-5)    uint256 public totalDeposits;    [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-GOV/SCWE-140/#__codelineno-1-6)    mapping(address => uint256) public balances; [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-GOV/SCWE-140/#__codelineno-1-7)    [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-GOV/SCWE-140/#__codelineno-1-8)    constructor() { owner = msg.sender; } [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-GOV/SCWE-140/#__codelineno-1-9)    [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-GOV/SCWE-140/#__codelineno-1-10)    function buyTokens() external payable {        [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-GOV/SCWE-140/#__codelineno-1-11)        balances[msg.sender] += msg.value;        [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-GOV/SCWE-140/#__codelineno-1-12)        totalDeposits += msg.value;    [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-GOV/SCWE-140/#__codelineno-1-13)    } [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-GOV/SCWE-140/#__codelineno-1-14)    [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-GOV/SCWE-140/#__codelineno-1-15)    function withdrawTokens() external {        [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-GOV/SCWE-140/#__codelineno-1-16)        uint256 amount = balances[msg.sender];        [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-GOV/SCWE-140/#__codelineno-1-17)        balances[msg.sender] = 0;        [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-GOV/SCWE-140/#__codelineno-1-18)        totalDeposits -= amount;        [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-GOV/SCWE-140/#__codelineno-1-19)        (bool ok, ) = msg.sender.call{value: amount}("");        [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-GOV/SCWE-140/#__codelineno-1-20)        require(ok, "Transfer failed");    [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-GOV/SCWE-140/#__codelineno-1-21)    } [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-GOV/SCWE-140/#__codelineno-1-22)    [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-GOV/SCWE-140/#__codelineno-1-23)    function rescueStuckETH() external {        [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-GOV/SCWE-140/#__codelineno-1-24)        require(msg.sender == owner, "Not owner");        [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-GOV/SCWE-140/#__codelineno-1-25)        uint256 excess = address(this).balance - totalDeposits;        [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-GOV/SCWE-140/#__codelineno-1-26)        require(excess > 0, "No excess");        [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-GOV/SCWE-140/#__codelineno-1-27)        (bool ok, ) = owner.call{value: excess}("");        [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-GOV/SCWE-140/#__codelineno-1-28)        require(ok, "Transfer failed");    [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-GOV/SCWE-140/#__codelineno-1-29)    } [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-GOV/SCWE-140/#__codelineno-1-30)}`

**Fix:** Track `totalDeposits` and only rescue ETH in excess of user deposits (e.g., from `selfdestruct`). `withdrawTokens` lets users claim their deposits; `rescueStuckETH` recovers only excess ETH.

title: SCWE-142: Extractable Value from Predictable Transaction Ordering
heading: Fixed[¶](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-GOV/SCWE-142/#fixed "Permanent link")
text:
*Last updated: August 19, 2026*



# SCWE-142: Extractable Value from Predictable Transaction Ordering

Stable Version v1.0

This content is in the **version-(v1.0)** and still under active development, so it is subject to change any time (e.g. structure, IDs, content, URLs, etc.).

[Send Feedback](https://github.com/OWASP/www-project-smart-contract-security-testing-guide/discussions/categories/scwe-scstg-v2-beta-feedback)


## Relationships[¶](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-GOV/SCWE-142/#relationships "Permanent link")

-   CWE-362: Concurrent Execution using Shared Resource with Improper Synchronization ('Race Condition')
    [https://cwe.mitre.org/data/definitions/362.html](https://cwe.mitre.org/data/definitions/362.html)


## Description[¶](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-GOV/SCWE-142/#description "Permanent link")

Contracts that create predictable, orderable state changes expose value to block builders and searchers (MEV). Sandwich attacks, backrunning, and liquidation front-running are examples. When a user's transaction has a predictable effect (e.g., large swap moving price), an attacker can place transactions before and after to extract value. SCWE-037 covers front-running; this weakness addresses the broader MEV surface—design choices that make extraction easy.


## Remediation[¶](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-GOV/SCWE-142/#remediation "Permanent link")

-   Use private mempools or commit-reveal schemes for sensitive transactions.
-   Implement slippage protection (SCWE-090) and deadline parameters (SCWE-141).
-   Consider batch auctions, fair ordering, or MEV-aware design (e.g., CoW Protocol) where applicable.


## Examples[¶](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-GOV/SCWE-142/#examples "Permanent link")


### Vulnerable[¶](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-GOV/SCWE-142/#vulnerable "Permanent link")

`[](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-GOV/SCWE-142/#__codelineno-0-1)pragma solidity ^0.8.0; [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-GOV/SCWE-142/#__codelineno-0-2)[](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-GOV/SCWE-142/#__codelineno-0-3)contract SimpleSwap {     [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-GOV/SCWE-142/#__codelineno-0-4)    function swap(uint256 amountIn, uint256 minOut) external {        [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-GOV/SCWE-142/#__codelineno-0-5)        // Predictable: searcher sees large amountIn, sandwiches with buy-before and sell-after        [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-GOV/SCWE-142/#__codelineno-0-6)        uint256 out = getAmountOut(amountIn);        [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-GOV/SCWE-142/#__codelineno-0-7)        require(out >= minOut, "Slippage");        [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-GOV/SCWE-142/#__codelineno-0-8)        transferOut(msg.sender, out);    [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-GOV/SCWE-142/#__codelineno-0-9)    } [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-GOV/SCWE-142/#__codelineno-0-10)}`


### Fixed[¶](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-GOV/SCWE-142/#fixed "Permanent link")

`[](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-GOV/SCWE-142/#__codelineno-1-1)function swap(uint256 amountIn, uint256 minOut, uint256 deadline) external {     [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-GOV/SCWE-142/#__codelineno-1-2)    require(block.timestamp <= deadline, "Expired");    [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-GOV/SCWE-142/#__codelineno-1-3)    uint256 out = getAmountOut(amountIn);    [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-GOV/SCWE-142/#__codelineno-1-4)    require(out >= minOut, "Slippage");    [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-GOV/SCWE-142/#__codelineno-1-5)    transferOut(msg.sender, out); [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-GOV/SCWE-142/#__codelineno-1-6)}`

**Fix:** User-supplied `deadline` and `minOut` limit MEV extraction. Use DEX aggregators or private order flow for additional protection.

title: SCWE-156: Missing Emergency Circuit Breaker for Critical Operations
heading: Mitigation[¶](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-GOV/SCWE-156/#mitigation "Permanent link")
text:
*Last updated: August 19, 2026*



# SCWE-156: Missing Emergency Circuit Breaker for Critical Operations

Stable Version v1.0

This content is in the **version-(v1.0)** and still under active development, so it is subject to change any time (e.g. structure, IDs, content, URLs, etc.).

[Send Feedback](https://github.com/OWASP/www-project-smart-contract-security-testing-guide/discussions/categories/scwe-scstg-v2-beta-feedback)


## Relationships[¶](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-GOV/SCWE-156/#relationships "Permanent link")

-   CWE-693: Protection Mechanism Failure
    [https://cwe.mitre.org/data/definitions/693.html](https://cwe.mitre.org/data/definitions/693.html)


## Description[¶](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-GOV/SCWE-156/#description "Permanent link")

A circuit breaker is a threshold-based or condition-based halt mechanism that stops critical operations when anomalies are detected (e.g., TVL drop >X%, unusual withdrawal volume, oracle deviation). Unlike simple pausability (SCWE-014), a circuit breaker automatically or semi-automatically triggers based on predefined conditions, providing an additional safety layer during attacks or market stress.


## Remediation[¶](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-GOV/SCWE-156/#remediation "Permanent link")

-   Implement circuit breakers that halt deposits, withdrawals, or swaps when thresholds are exceeded.
-   Use oracle-based triggers (e.g., price deviation) or rate-limit triggers.
-   Ensure the circuit breaker can be reset by governance or after cooldown.


## Examples[¶](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-GOV/SCWE-156/#examples "Permanent link")


### Vulnerable[¶](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-GOV/SCWE-156/#vulnerable "Permanent link")

`[](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-GOV/SCWE-156/#__codelineno-0-1)pragma solidity ^0.8.0; [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-GOV/SCWE-156/#__codelineno-0-2)[](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-GOV/SCWE-156/#__codelineno-0-3)contract LendingPool {     [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-GOV/SCWE-156/#__codelineno-0-4)    mapping(address => uint256) public balances;    [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-GOV/SCWE-156/#__codelineno-0-5)    uint256 public totalDeposits; [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-GOV/SCWE-156/#__codelineno-0-6)    [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-GOV/SCWE-156/#__codelineno-0-7)    function deposit() external payable {        [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-GOV/SCWE-156/#__codelineno-0-8)        balances[msg.sender] += msg.value;        [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-GOV/SCWE-156/#__codelineno-0-9)        totalDeposits += msg.value;    [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-GOV/SCWE-156/#__codelineno-0-10)    } [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-GOV/SCWE-156/#__codelineno-0-11)    [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-GOV/SCWE-156/#__codelineno-0-12)    function withdraw(uint256 amount) external {        [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-GOV/SCWE-156/#__codelineno-0-13)        require(balances[msg.sender] >= amount, "Insufficient");        [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-GOV/SCWE-156/#__codelineno-0-14)        balances[msg.sender] -= amount;        [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-GOV/SCWE-156/#__codelineno-0-15)        totalDeposits -= amount;        [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-GOV/SCWE-156/#__codelineno-0-16)        (bool ok, ) = msg.sender.call{value: amount}("");        [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-GOV/SCWE-156/#__codelineno-0-17)        require(ok, "Transfer failed");    [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-GOV/SCWE-156/#__codelineno-0-18)    } [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-GOV/SCWE-156/#__codelineno-0-19)}`

**Gap:** No circuit breaker. A flash loan or oracle attack could drain funds before anyone can pause.

# SCWE-028: Price Oracle Manipulation

Stable Version v1.0

This content is in the **version-(v1.0)** and still under active development, so it is subject to change any time (e.g. structure, IDs, content, URLs, etc.).

[Send Feedback](https://github.com/OWASP/www-project-smart-contract-security-testing-guide/discussions/categories/scwe-scstg-v2-beta-feedback)


## Relationships[¶](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-ORACLE/SCWE-028/#relationships "Permanent link")

-   CWE-20: Improper Input Validation
    [CWE-20 Link](https://cwe.mitre.org/data/definitions/20.html)


## Description[¶](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-ORACLE/SCWE-028/#description "Permanent link")

Price Oracle manipulation refers to the exploitation of vulnerabilities in price oracles to manipulate contract logic. This can lead to: - Unauthorized actions by malicious actors. - Loss of funds or data. - Exploitation of the contract's logic.


## Remediation[¶](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-ORACLE/SCWE-028/#remediation "Permanent link")

-   **Use decentralized oracles:** Leverage multiple decentralized oracles for price data.
-   **Validate inputs:** Ensure all oracle data is properly validated before use.
-   **Implement circuit breakers:** Add mechanisms to halt operations in case of suspicious activity.

## Examples[¶](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-ORACLE/SCWE-028/#examples "Permanent link")

-   **Vulnerable to Oracle Manipulation**\- Exploiting Weak Price Feeds

-   Flash Loan-Based Price Manipulation

    `[](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-ORACLE/SCWE-028/#__codelineno-0-1)pragma solidity ^0.8.0; [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-ORACLE/SCWE-028/#__codelineno-0-2)[](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-ORACLE/SCWE-028/#__codelineno-0-3)interface Oracle {     [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-ORACLE/SCWE-028/#__codelineno-0-4)    function getPrice() external view returns (uint); [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-ORACLE/SCWE-028/#__codelineno-0-5)} [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-ORACLE/SCWE-028/#__codelineno-0-6)[](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-ORACLE/SCWE-028/#__codelineno-0-7)contract VulnerableLending {     [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-ORACLE/SCWE-028/#__codelineno-0-8)    Oracle public priceOracle;    [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-ORACLE/SCWE-028/#__codelineno-0-9)    mapping(address => uint) public balances; [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-ORACLE/SCWE-028/#__codelineno-0-10)    [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-ORACLE/SCWE-028/#__codelineno-0-11)    constructor(address _oracle) {        [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-ORACLE/SCWE-028/#__codelineno-0-12)        priceOracle = Oracle(_oracle);    [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-ORACLE/SCWE-028/#__codelineno-0-13)    } [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-ORACLE/SCWE-028/#__codelineno-0-14)    [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-ORACLE/SCWE-028/#__codelineno-0-15)    function deposit() external payable {        [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-ORACLE/SCWE-028/#__codelineno-0-16)        balances[msg.sender] += msg.value * priceOracle.getPrice();    [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-ORACLE/SCWE-028/#__codelineno-0-17)    } [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-ORACLE/SCWE-028/#__codelineno-0-18)    [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-ORACLE/SCWE-028/#__codelineno-0-19)    function withdraw(uint amount) external {        [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-ORACLE/SCWE-028/#__codelineno-0-20)        require(balances[msg.sender] >= amount, "Insufficient balance");        [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-ORACLE/SCWE-028/#__codelineno-0-21)        balances[msg.sender] -= amount;        [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-ORACLE/SCWE-028/#__codelineno-0-22)        (bool ok, ) = msg.sender.call{value: amount / priceOracle.getPrice()}(""); // Uses current price        [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-ORACLE/SCWE-028/#__codelineno-0-23)        require(ok, "Transfer failed");    [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-ORACLE/SCWE-028/#__codelineno-0-24)    } [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-ORACLE/SCWE-028/#__codelineno-0-25)}`


Why is this vulnerable?

-   Flash loan attack: The attacker can manipulate the price before calling withdraw(), draining funds.
-   No validation mechanism to reject manipulated prices.

# SCWE-029: Lack of Decentralized Oracle Sources

Stable Version v1.0

This content is in the **version-(v1.0)** and still under active development, so it is subject to change any time (e.g. structure, IDs, content, URLs, etc.).

[Send Feedback](https://github.com/OWASP/www-project-smart-contract-security-testing-guide/discussions/categories/scwe-scstg-v2-beta-feedback)


## Relationships[¶](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-ORACLE/SCWE-029/#relationships "Permanent link")

-   CWE-20: Improper Input Validation
    [CWE-20 Link](https://cwe.mitre.org/data/definitions/20.html)


## Description[¶](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-ORACLE/SCWE-029/#description "Permanent link")

Lack of decentralized oracle sources refers to the reliance on a single oracle for critical data, which can be manipulated or compromised. This can lead to: - Unauthorized actions by malicious actors. - Loss of funds or data. - Exploitation of the contract's logic.


## Remediation[¶](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-ORACLE/SCWE-029/#remediation "Permanent link")

-   **Use multiple oracles:** Leverage multiple decentralized oracles for critical data.
-   **Validate inputs:** Ensure all oracle data is properly validated before use.
-   **Implement fallback mechanisms:** Use fallback oracles in case of failure.

## Examples[¶](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-ORACLE/SCWE-029/#examples "Permanent link")

-   **Single Oracle Source/ Single Point of Failure**

    `[](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-ORACLE/SCWE-029/#__codelineno-0-1)pragma solidity ^0.8.0; [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-ORACLE/SCWE-029/#__codelineno-0-2)[](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-ORACLE/SCWE-029/#__codelineno-0-3)interface Oracle {     [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-ORACLE/SCWE-029/#__codelineno-0-4)    function getPrice() external view returns (uint); [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-ORACLE/SCWE-029/#__codelineno-0-5)} [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-ORACLE/SCWE-029/#__codelineno-0-6)[](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-ORACLE/SCWE-029/#__codelineno-0-7)contract SingleOracle {     [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-ORACLE/SCWE-029/#__codelineno-0-8)    Oracle public priceOracle; [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-ORACLE/SCWE-029/#__codelineno-0-9)    [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-ORACLE/SCWE-029/#__codelineno-0-10)    constructor(address _oracle) {        [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-ORACLE/SCWE-029/#__codelineno-0-11)        priceOracle = Oracle(_oracle);    [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-ORACLE/SCWE-029/#__codelineno-0-12)    } [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-ORACLE/SCWE-029/#__codelineno-0-13)    [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-ORACLE/SCWE-029/#__codelineno-0-14)    function getPrice() public view returns (uint) {        [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-ORACLE/SCWE-029/#__codelineno-0-15)        return priceOracle.getPrice(); // Single source of truth    [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-ORACLE/SCWE-029/#__codelineno-0-16)    } [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-ORACLE/SCWE-029/#__codelineno-0-17)}`


Why is this vulnerable? - If the oracle fails, is compromised, or is manipulated, the contract has no fallback. - Attackers could hijack the single oracle and return malicious data.

    `[](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-ORACLE/SCWE-029/#__codelineno-1-1)pragma solidity ^0.8.0; [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-ORACLE/SCWE-029/#__codelineno-1-2)[](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-ORACLE/SCWE-029/#__codelineno-1-3)interface Oracle {     [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-ORACLE/SCWE-029/#__codelineno-1-4)    function getPrice() external view returns (uint); [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-ORACLE/SCWE-029/#__codelineno-1-5)} [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-ORACLE/SCWE-029/#__codelineno-1-6)[](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-ORACLE/SCWE-029/#__codelineno-1-7)contract MultiOracle {     [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-ORACLE/SCWE-029/#__codelineno-1-8)    Oracle[] public priceOracles; [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-ORACLE/SCWE-029/#__codelineno-1-9)    [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-ORACLE/SCWE-029/#__codelineno-1-10)    constructor(address[] memory _oracles) {        [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-ORACLE/SCWE-029/#__codelineno-1-11)        for (uint i = 0; i < _oracles.length; i++) {            [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-ORACLE/SCWE-029/#__codelineno-1-12)            priceOracles.push(Oracle(_oracles[i]));        [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-ORACLE/SCWE-029/#__codelineno-1-13)        }    [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-ORACLE/SCWE-029/#__codelineno-1-14)    } [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-ORACLE/SCWE-029/#__codelineno-1-15)    [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-ORACLE/SCWE-029/#__codelineno-1-16)    function getPrice() public view returns (uint) {        [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-ORACLE/SCWE-029/#__codelineno-1-17)        uint totalPrice = 0;        [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-ORACLE/SCWE-029/#__codelineno-1-18)        for (uint i = 0; i < priceOracles.length; i++) {            [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-ORACLE/SCWE-029/#__codelineno-1-19)            totalPrice += priceOracles[i].getPrice(); # SCWE-030: Insecure Oracle Data Updates

Stable Version v1.0

This content is in the **version-(v1.0)** and still under active development, so it is subject to change any time (e.g. structure, IDs, content, URLs, etc.).

[Send Feedback](https://github.com/OWASP/www-project-smart-contract-security-testing-guide/discussions/categories/scwe-scstg-v2-beta-feedback)


## Relationships[¶](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-ORACLE/SCWE-030/#relationships "Permanent link")

-   CWE-20: Improper Input Validation
    [CWE-20 Link](https://cwe.mitre.org/data/definitions/20.html)


## Description[¶](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-ORACLE/SCWE-030/#description "Permanent link")

Insecure oracle data updates refer to the failure to properly validate or secure updates to oracle data. This can lead to: - Unauthorized actions by malicious actors. - Loss of funds or data. - Exploitation of the contract's logic.


## Remediation[¶](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-ORACLE/SCWE-030/#remediation "Permanent link")

-   **Validate updates:** Ensure all oracle data updates are properly validated.
-   **Restrict access:** Restrict update permissions to trusted addresses.
-   **Implement timelocks:** Add delays to oracle updates to allow for review.


## Examples[¶](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-ORACLE/SCWE-030/#examples "Permanent link")

-   **Insecure Oracle Updates**

    `[](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-ORACLE/SCWE-030/#__codelineno-0-1)pragma solidity ^0.8.0; [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-ORACLE/SCWE-030/#__codelineno-0-2)[](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-ORACLE/SCWE-030/#__codelineno-0-3)contract InsecureOracleUpdates {     [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-ORACLE/SCWE-030/#__codelineno-0-4)    function updatePrice(address oracle, uint newPrice) public {        [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-ORACLE/SCWE-030/#__codelineno-0-5)        Oracle(oracle).updatePrice(newPrice); // No validation    [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-ORACLE/SCWE-030/#__codelineno-0-6)    } [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-ORACLE/SCWE-030/#__codelineno-0-7)}`

-   **Secure Oracle Updates**

    `[](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-ORACLE/SCWE-030/#__codelineno-1-1)pragma solidity ^0.8.0; [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-ORACLE/SCWE-030/#__codelineno-1-2)[](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-ORACLE/SCWE-030/#__codelineno-1-3)contract SecureOracleUpdates {     [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-ORACLE/SCWE-030/#__codelineno-1-4)    address public admin; [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-ORACLE/SCWE-030/#__codelineno-1-5)    [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-ORACLE/SCWE-030/#__codelineno-1-6)    constructor(address _admin) {        [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-ORACLE/SCWE-030/#__codelineno-1-7)        admin = _admin;    [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-ORACLE/SCWE-030/#__codelineno-1-8)    } [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-ORACLE/SCWE-030/#__codelineno-1-9)    [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-ORACLE/SCWE-030/#__codelineno-1-10)    modifier onlyAdmin() {        [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-ORACLE/SCWE-030/#__codelineno-1-11)        require(msg.sender == admin, "Unauthorized");        [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-ORACLE/SCWE-030/#__codelineno-1-12)        _;    [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-ORACLE/SCWE-030/#__codelineno-1-13)    } [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-ORACLE/SCWE-030/#__codelineno-1-14)    [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-ORACLE/SCWE-030/#__codelineno-1-15)    function updatePrice(address oracle, uint newPrice) public onlyAdmin {        [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-ORACLE/SCWE-030/#__codelineno-1-16)        Oracle(oracle).updatePrice(newPrice); // Restricted to admin    [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-ORACLE/SCWE-030/#__codelineno-1-17)    } [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-ORACLE/SCWE-030/#__codelineno-1-18)}`

# SCWE-085: Misuse of Oracle Min/Max Price Band Without Validation

Stable Version v1.0

This content is in the **version-(v1.0)** and still under active development, so it is subject to change any time (e.g. structure, IDs, content, URLs, etc.).

[Send Feedback](https://github.com/OWASP/www-project-smart-contract-security-testing-guide/discussions/categories/scwe-scstg-v2-beta-feedback)


## Relationships[¶](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-ORACLE/SCWE-085/#relationships "Permanent link")

-   **CWE-345**: [Insufficient Verification of Data Authenticity](https://cwe.mitre.org/data/definitions/345.html)
-   **CWE-20**: [Improper Input Validation](https://cwe.mitre.org/data/definitions/20.html)

* * *


## Description[¶](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-ORACLE/SCWE-085/#description "Permanent link")

This weakness occurs when smart contracts consume price oracle data (e.g., from Chainlink) without verifying whether the returned price falls within an expected or trusted range (e.g., `minPrice`/`maxPrice`). Oracles may return fallback floor or ceiling values when actual prices exceed internal limits or when the feed encounters data instability.

Failing to detect and reject such edge-case values can result in incorrect or exploitable logic paths in smart contracts. This weakness may allow attackers to:

-   Trigger mispriced swaps or asset conversions.
-   Exploit collateralization thresholds.
-   Manipulate auction pricing or tiered reward structures.
-   Influence governance systems based on price weightings.

These issues are especially dangerous during periods of high volatility or partial oracle outages, where fallback values may be automatically returned.

* * *


## Remediation[¶](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-ORACLE/SCWE-085/#remediation "Permanent link")

To mitigate this risk:

-   Always verify that the oracle-provided price lies within an expected range.
-   Check whether the returned value is a fallback boundary by comparing it against known `minPrice`/`maxPrice` values.
-   Monitor and log unusual oracle values for off-chain alerts and incident response.

* * *


## Example[¶](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-ORACLE/SCWE-085/#example "Permanent link")

-   Vulnerable contract

`[](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-ORACLE/SCWE-085/#__codelineno-0-1)(int256 price,,,) = AggregatorV3Interface(oracle).latestRoundData(); [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-ORACLE/SCWE-085/#__codelineno-0-2)[](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-ORACLE/SCWE-085/#__codelineno-0-3)// Uses price directly without checking for boundary values [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-ORACLE/SCWE-085/#__codelineno-0-4)uint256 tokenAmount = uint256(price) * userInput;`

\- Fixed Contract

`[](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-ORACLE/SCWE-085/#__codelineno-1-1)(int256 price,,,) = AggregatorV3Interface(oracle).latestRoundData(); [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-ORACLE/SCWE-085/#__codelineno-1-2)[](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-ORACLE/SCWE-085/#__codelineno-1-3)// Validate that the price is within trusted bounds [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-ORACLE/SCWE-085/#__codelineno-1-4)require(price > minPrice && price < maxPrice, "Price out of expected bounds"); [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-ORACLE/SCWE-085/#__codelineno-1-5)[](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-ORACLE/SCWE-085/#__codelineno-1-6)uint256 tokenAmount = uint256(price) * userInput;`

This ensures that the contract rejects unexpected oracle values that might be returned during errors or manipulation attempts.


## References[¶](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-ORACLE/SCWE-085/#references "Permanent link")

-   **Chainlink Docs**: [Chainlink Price Feeds Documentation](https://docs.chain.link/data-feeds)

-   **CWE-20**: [Improper Input Validation](https://cwe.mitre.org/data/definitions/20.html)

# SCWE-086: Missing Validation of Oracle Response Fields (Stale or Incomplete Data)

Stable Version v1.0

This content is in the **version-(v1.0)** and still under active development, so it is subject to change any time (e.g. structure, IDs, content, URLs, etc.).

[Send Feedback](https://github.com/OWASP/www-project-smart-contract-security-testing-guide/discussions/categories/scwe-scstg-v2-beta-feedback)


## Relationships[¶](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-ORACLE/SCWE-086/#relationships "Permanent link")

-   **CWE-345**: [Insufficient Verification of Data Authenticity](https://cwe.mitre.org/data/definitions/345.html)
-   **CWE-20**: [Improper Input Validation](https://cwe.mitre.org/data/definitions/20.html)


## Description[¶](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-ORACLE/SCWE-086/#description "Permanent link")

This weakness occurs when smart contracts consume data from oracles (e.g., Chainlink) without validating critical fields in the response such as `answeredInRound`, `timestamp`, or even the `answer` itself. Failing to validate these fields can lead to:

-   Use of stale price data from old oracle rounds.
-   Acceptance of incomplete oracle responses (e.g., `timestamp == 0`).
-   Execution based on invalid or zero-priced data.

This can severely affect the security of DeFi protocols or any smart contract relying on accurate, fresh data feeds.


## Remediation[¶](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-ORACLE/SCWE-086/#remediation "Permanent link")

-   **Validate `answer` field:** Ensure the value returned is greater than zero and not malformed.
-   **Check `answeredInRound >= roundId`:** Confirms that the data is not from a stale round.
-   **Verify `timestamp != 0`:** Ensures that the oracle actually returned a complete result.

Additional best practices include: - Using fallback mechanisms or thresholds for deviation checks. - Halting sensitive functions if oracle data is suspect or missing.


## Examples[¶](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-ORACLE/SCWE-086/#examples "Permanent link")

-   **❌ Vulnerable Code (No Response Validation)**

    `[](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-ORACLE/SCWE-086/#__codelineno-0-1)(, int256 answer,,,) = AggregatorV3Interface(oracle).latestRoundData(); [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-ORACLE/SCWE-086/#__codelineno-0-2)require(uint256(answer) > 0, "Zero price"); // Minimal check only`

-   **✅ Secure Code (With Full Oracle Validation)**

    `[](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-ORACLE/SCWE-086/#__codelineno-1-1)(uint80 roundID, int256 answer,, uint256 timestamp, uint80 answeredInRound) =      [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-ORACLE/SCWE-086/#__codelineno-1-2)    AggregatorV3Interface(oracle).latestRoundData(); [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-ORACLE/SCWE-086/#__codelineno-1-3)[](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-ORACLE/SCWE-086/#__codelineno-1-4)require(answer > 0, "Invalid price: <= 0"); [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-ORACLE/SCWE-086/#__codelineno-1-5)require(answeredInRound >= roundID, "Stale round data"); [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-ORACLE/SCWE-086/#__codelineno-1-6)require(timestamp != 0, "Incomplete oracle response");`



## References[¶](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-ORACLE/SCWE-086/#references "Permanent link")

-   [Chainlink Oracle Security Best Practices](https://docs.chain.link/data-feeds/security/)

# SCWE-088: Improper Decimal Normalization in Price-Based Calculations

Stable Version v1.0

This content is in the **version-(v1.0)** and still under active development, so it is subject to change any time (e.g. structure, IDs, content, URLs, etc.).

[Send Feedback](https://github.com/OWASP/www-project-smart-contract-security-testing-guide/discussions/categories/scwe-scstg-v2-beta-feedback)


## Relationships[¶](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-ORACLE/SCWE-088/#relationships "Permanent link")

-   **CWE-681**: [Incorrect Conversion between Numeric Types](https://cwe.mitre.org/data/definitions/681.html)
-   **CWE-682**: [Incorrect Calculation](https://cwe.mitre.org/data/definitions/682.html)


## Description[¶](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-ORACLE/SCWE-088/#description "Permanent link")

This issue arises when smart contracts perform arithmetic involving token values and price feeds without properly aligning decimal places across different sources (e.g. ERC-20 tokens with varying decimals and Chainlink oracles with fixed 8-decimal prices). Failing to normalize decimals before calculations can lead to severely inflated or deflated results, causing users to be overcharged, underpaid, or otherwise economically exploited.


## Impact[¶](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-ORACLE/SCWE-088/#impact "Permanent link")

Smart contracts often rely on cross-asset conversions, such as paying fees in tokens or using collateralization logic involving price feeds. Improper decimal handling in these calculations may: - Lead to gross overcharging or underpayment. - Introduce systemic financial imbalances in vaults or accounting logic. - Enable economic exploits by arbitraging rounding errors or precision gaps. - Remain undetected during tests if decimals coincidentally align. This issue is especially critical when: - ERC-20 tokens with non-18 decimals (e.g., USDC = 6) are involved. - Chainlink oracles return 8-decimal fixed-point prices. - Arithmetic mixes native ETH values (in 18 decimals) with token values or prices.

* * *


## Remediation[¶](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-ORACLE/SCWE-088/#remediation "Permanent link")

-   Always normalize decimals across all involved assets and feeds.
-   Use centralized utility functions for all price/token conversions.
-   Add sanity checks to detect outlier results (e.g., revert if output is >1000x expected range).
-   When possible, emit intermediate calculation steps for auditing.


## Examples[¶](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-ORACLE/SCWE-088/#examples "Permanent link")

-   **❌ Vulnerable Code (Missing Decimal Normalization)**

    `[](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-ORACLE/SCWE-088/#__codelineno-0-1)// Assume ETH/USD = 3000e8 (8 decimals), Token/USD = 1e8, and token has 6 decimals [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-ORACLE/SCWE-088/#__codelineno-0-2)uint256 tokenAmount = (ethAmountInWei * ethPriceInUsd) / tokenPriceInUsd; [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-ORACLE/SCWE-088/#__codelineno-0-3)// Result is in 18-decimal scale, not adjusted for the 6-decimal USDC token`

-   **✅ Safe Code (With Proper Decimal Alignment)**

    `[](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-ORACLE/SCWE-088/#__codelineno-1-1)uint8 tokenDecimals = IERC20(token).decimals(); [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-ORACLE/SCWE-088/#__codelineno-1-2)[](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-ORACLE/SCWE-088/#__codelineno-1-3)uint256 rawAmount = (ethAmountInWei * ethPriceInUsd) / tokenPriceInUsd; [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-ORACLE/SCWE-088/#__codelineno-1-4)uint256 adjustedAmount = rawAmount / (10 ** (18 - tokenDecimals)); [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-ORACLE/SCWE-088/#__codelineno-1-5)// Now 'adjustedAmount' is in correct units for the target token`



## Realistic Exploit Example[¶](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-ORACLE/SCWE-088/#realistic-exploit-example "Permanent link")

Assumptions:

title: SCWE-112: Reliance on Low-Liquidity Spot Prices
heading: Fixed[¶](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-ORACLE/SCWE-112/#fixed "Permanent link")
text:
*Last updated: August 19, 2026*



# SCWE-112: Reliance on Low-Liquidity Spot Prices

Stable Version v1.0

This content is in the **version-(v1.0)** and still under active development, so it is subject to change any time (e.g. structure, IDs, content, URLs, etc.).

[Send Feedback](https://github.com/OWASP/www-project-smart-contract-security-testing-guide/discussions/categories/scwe-scstg-v2-beta-feedback)


## Relationships[¶](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-ORACLE/SCWE-112/#relationships "Permanent link")

-   CWE-346: Origin Validation Error
    [https://cwe.mitre.org/data/definitions/346.html](https://cwe.mitre.org/data/definitions/346.html)


## Description[¶](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-ORACLE/SCWE-112/#description "Permanent link")

Using a single on-chain DEX spot price from an illiquid pool lets attackers move the price with small trades or flash loans, then exploit inflated/deflated valuations for lending, liquidations, or swaps.


## Remediation[¶](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-ORACLE/SCWE-112/#remediation "Permanent link")

-   Require minimum liquidity thresholds and sanity bounds before trusting a pool.
-   Use robust oracles (Chainlink, TWAP, median of multiple feeds) instead of raw spot prices.
-   Apply deviation checks against reference feeds and revert when deviation exceeds limits.


## Examples[¶](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-ORACLE/SCWE-112/#examples "Permanent link")


### Vulnerable[¶](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-ORACLE/SCWE-112/#vulnerable "Permanent link")

`[](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-ORACLE/SCWE-112/#__codelineno-0-1)pragma solidity ^0.8.0; [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-ORACLE/SCWE-112/#__codelineno-0-2)[](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-ORACLE/SCWE-112/#__codelineno-0-3)contract Lending {     [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-ORACLE/SCWE-112/#__codelineno-0-4)    IUniswapV2Pair public pair; [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-ORACLE/SCWE-112/#__codelineno-0-5)    [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-ORACLE/SCWE-112/#__codelineno-0-6)    function getPrice() public view returns (uint256) {        [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-ORACLE/SCWE-112/#__codelineno-0-7)        (uint112 r0, uint112 r1,) = pair.getReserves();        [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-ORACLE/SCWE-112/#__codelineno-0-8)        return uint256(r1) * 1e18 / r0; // trusts small pool    [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-ORACLE/SCWE-112/#__codelineno-0-9)    } [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-ORACLE/SCWE-112/#__codelineno-0-10)}`


### Fixed[¶](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-ORACLE/SCWE-112/#fixed "Permanent link")

`[](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-ORACLE/SCWE-112/#__codelineno-1-1)pragma solidity ^0.8.0; [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-ORACLE/SCWE-112/#__codelineno-1-2)[](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-ORACLE/SCWE-112/#__codelineno-1-3)contract Lending {     [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-ORACLE/SCWE-112/#__codelineno-1-4)    IAggregatorV3 public chainlink; [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-ORACLE/SCWE-112/#__codelineno-1-5)    [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-ORACLE/SCWE-112/#__codelineno-1-6)    function getPrice() public view returns (uint256) {        [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-ORACLE/SCWE-112/#__codelineno-1-7)        (, int256 price,,,) = chainlink.latestRoundData();        [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-ORACLE/SCWE-112/#__codelineno-1-8)        require(price > 0, "stale");        [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-ORACLE/SCWE-112/#__codelineno-1-9)        return uint256(price);    [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-ORACLE/SCWE-112/#__codelineno-1-10)    } [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-ORACLE/SCWE-112/#__codelineno-1-11)}`

title: SCWE-113: Insufficient TWAP Window or Single Observation
heading: Fixed[¶](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-ORACLE/SCWE-113/#fixed "Permanent link")
text:
*Last updated: August 19, 2026*



# SCWE-113: Insufficient TWAP Window or Single Observation

Stable Version v1.0

This content is in the **version-(v1.0)** and still under active development, so it is subject to change any time (e.g. structure, IDs, content, URLs, etc.).

[Send Feedback](https://github.com/OWASP/www-project-smart-contract-security-testing-guide/discussions/categories/scwe-scstg-v2-beta-feedback)


## Relationships[¶](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-ORACLE/SCWE-113/#relationships "Permanent link")

-   CWE-346: Origin Validation Error
    [https://cwe.mitre.org/data/definitions/346.html](https://cwe.mitre.org/data/definitions/346.html)


## Description[¶](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-ORACLE/SCWE-113/#description "Permanent link")

TWAP oracles that use very short windows or a single cumulative observation can be manipulated within a block or a few trades. Attackers can swing the average price temporarily to borrow, liquidate, or mint at a favorable rate.


## Remediation[¶](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-ORACLE/SCWE-113/#remediation "Permanent link")

-   Use sufficiently long averaging windows and multiple observations with minimum elapsed time.
-   Enforce maximum per-block updates to prevent same-block manipulation.
-   Cross-check TWAP output against external reference feeds or deviation thresholds.


## Examples[¶](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-ORACLE/SCWE-113/#examples "Permanent link")


### Vulnerable[¶](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-ORACLE/SCWE-113/#vulnerable "Permanent link")

`[](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-ORACLE/SCWE-113/#__codelineno-0-1)pragma solidity ^0.8.0; [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-ORACLE/SCWE-113/#__codelineno-0-2)[](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-ORACLE/SCWE-113/#__codelineno-0-3)interface IUniswapV3Pool {     [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-ORACLE/SCWE-113/#__codelineno-0-4)    function observe(uint32[] calldata secondsAgos)        [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-ORACLE/SCWE-113/#__codelineno-0-5)        external view returns (int56[] memory tickCumulatives, uint160[] memory); [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-ORACLE/SCWE-113/#__codelineno-0-6)} [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-ORACLE/SCWE-113/#__codelineno-0-7)[](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-ORACLE/SCWE-113/#__codelineno-0-8)contract PriceFeed {     [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-ORACLE/SCWE-113/#__codelineno-0-9)    IUniswapV3Pool public pool; [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-ORACLE/SCWE-113/#__codelineno-0-10)    [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-ORACLE/SCWE-113/#__codelineno-0-11)    function twap() external view returns (int56) {        [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-ORACLE/SCWE-113/#__codelineno-0-12)        uint32[] memory secondsAgos = new uint32[](1);        [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-ORACLE/SCWE-113/#__codelineno-0-13)        secondsAgos[0] = 0; // single observation at current block — manipulatable in same block        [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-ORACLE/SCWE-113/#__codelineno-0-14)        (int56[] memory tickCumulatives,) = pool.observe(secondsAgos);        [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-ORACLE/SCWE-113/#__codelineno-0-15)        return tickCumulatives[0];    [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-ORACLE/SCWE-113/#__codelineno-0-16)    } [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-ORACLE/SCWE-113/#__codelineno-0-17)}`

title: SCWE-113: Insufficient TWAP Window or Single Observation
heading: Fixed[¶](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-ORACLE/SCWE-113/#fixed "Permanent link")
text:
### Fixed[¶](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-ORACLE/SCWE-113/#fixed "Permanent link")

`[](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-ORACLE/SCWE-113/#__codelineno-1-1)pragma solidity ^0.8.0; [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-ORACLE/SCWE-113/#__codelineno-1-2)[](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-ORACLE/SCWE-113/#__codelineno-1-3)interface IUniswapV3Pool {     [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-ORACLE/SCWE-113/#__codelineno-1-4)    function observe(uint32[] calldata secondsAgos)        [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-ORACLE/SCWE-113/#__codelineno-1-5)        external view returns (int56[] memory tickCumulatives, uint160[] memory); [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-ORACLE/SCWE-113/#__codelineno-1-6)} [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-ORACLE/SCWE-113/#__codelineno-1-7)[](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-ORACLE/SCWE-113/#__codelineno-1-8)contract PriceFeed {     [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-ORACLE/SCWE-113/#__codelineno-1-9)    IUniswapV3Pool public pool;    [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-ORACLE/SCWE-113/#__codelineno-1-10)    uint32 public constant TWAP_WINDOW = 1 hours; [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-ORACLE/SCWE-113/#__codelineno-1-11)    [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-ORACLE/SCWE-113/#__codelineno-1-12)    function twap() external view returns (int24) {        [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-ORACLE/SCWE-113/#__codelineno-1-13)        uint32[] memory secondsAgos = new uint32[](2);        [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-ORACLE/SCWE-113/#__codelineno-1-14)        secondsAgos[0] = TWAP_WINDOW; // start of window        [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-ORACLE/SCWE-113/#__codelineno-1-15)        secondsAgos[1] = 0;           // current block        [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-ORACLE/SCWE-113/#__codelineno-1-16)        (int56[] memory tickCumulatives,) = pool.observe(secondsAgos);        [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-ORACLE/SCWE-113/#__codelineno-1-17)        int56 tickDelta = tickCumulatives[1] - tickCumulatives[0];        [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-ORACLE/SCWE-113/#__codelineno-1-18)        return int24(tickDelta / int56(uint56(TWAP_WINDOW)));    [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-ORACLE/SCWE-113/#__codelineno-1-19)    } [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-ORACLE/SCWE-113/#__codelineno-1-20)}`

title: SCWE-130: Admin-Write Oracle Without Delay

*Last updated: August 19, 2026*



# SCWE-130: Admin-Write Oracle Without Delay

Stable Version v1.0

This content is in the **version-(v1.0)** and still under active development, so it is subject to change any time (e.g. structure, IDs, content, URLs, etc.).

[Send Feedback](https://github.com/OWASP/www-project-smart-contract-security-testing-guide/discussions/categories/scwe-scstg-v2-beta-feedback)


## Relationships[¶](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-ORACLE/SCWE-130/#relationships "Permanent link")

-   CWE-346: Origin Validation Error
    [https://cwe.mitre.org/data/definitions/346.html](https://cwe.mitre.org/data/definitions/346.html)


## Description[¶](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-ORACLE/SCWE-130/#description "Permanent link")

Price feeds that allow an admin to push arbitrary values immediately (no delay or quorum) let insiders force liquidations, manipulate collateralization, or drain AMMs. Even trusted operators can be compromised.


## Remediation[¶](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-ORACLE/SCWE-130/#remediation "Permanent link")

-   Require multi-sig + timelock for manual price pushes; emit events for monitoring.
-   Use decentralized oracles with aggregation/quorum instead of single-writer feeds.
-   Enforce bounds/deviation checks against reference feeds and reject outliers.


## Examples[¶](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-ORACLE/SCWE-130/#examples "Permanent link")


### Vulnerable[¶](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-ORACLE/SCWE-130/#vulnerable "Permanent link")

`[](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-ORACLE/SCWE-130/#__codelineno-0-1)function setPrice(uint256 p) external onlyOwner {     [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-ORACLE/SCWE-130/#__codelineno-0-2)    price = p; // immediate effect [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-ORACLE/SCWE-130/#__codelineno-0-3)}`


### Fixed[¶](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-ORACLE/SCWE-130/#fixed "Permanent link")

`[](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-ORACLE/SCWE-130/#__codelineno-1-1)function queuePrice(uint256 p) external onlyGuardian {     [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-ORACLE/SCWE-130/#__codelineno-1-2)    queued = Price({val:p, eta:block.timestamp + delay}); [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-ORACLE/SCWE-130/#__codelineno-1-3)} [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-ORACLE/SCWE-130/#__codelineno-1-4)function execute() external {     [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-ORACLE/SCWE-130/#__codelineno-1-5)    require(block.timestamp >= queued.eta, "too early");    [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-ORACLE/SCWE-130/#__codelineno-1-6)    price = queued.val; [](https://scs.owasp.org/SCWE/SCSVS-ORACLE/SCWE-130/#__codelineno-1-7)}`
